Trump and Musk know if Brad Schimel wins the Wisconsin Supreme Court race, he’ll be the deciding vote on the Court and in a perfect position to rubber stamp the MAGA agenda. And Brad Schimel hasn’t been shy about groveling for money from big right-wing donors like Musk — he’s bragged he had to buy knee pads so he could crawl on his knees and beg for cash. “Kneepad Brad” is what people are calling him.
The Wisconsin Supreme Court is not for sale. We shouldn't have someone bought and paid for by Elon Musk as the deciding vote on the Court. We should have a decent, honest judge like Judge Susan Crawford who actually rules based on the law.

New Info on Biden Abuse

[INSIDE JW]

JUDICIAL WATCH SUES FOR INFORMATION ON MISCONDUCT BY JACK SMITH’S
STAFF

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34873&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj0wQ09IcHA2OF8ySSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=7202540efabcec9c8dc9cc5fc304ec5373ea0f2ded07d582ea7276622ab617a9]

We aim to uncover the truth about the Biden administration’s lawfare
against President Trump and the US Constitution.

Judicial Watch just filed a FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34869&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWphY2stc21pdGhzLXRlYW0tY29tcGxhaW50LTAwODAxLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=0974c21646e954394a1dab2db013a795537fa3d9abe230d6b3fce9b73f596e83]
against the Justice Department for details of any investigations,
inquiries, or referrals concerning potential misconduct of any person
working for Special Counsel Jack Smith (_Judicial Watch Inc. v U.S.
Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34869&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWphY2stc21pdGhzLXRlYW0tY29tcGxhaW50LTAwODAxLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=0974c21646e954394a1dab2db013a795537fa3d9abe230d6b3fce9b73f596e83]
(No. 1:25-cv-00801)).

We sued after the Justice Department failed to respond to two FOIA
requests on December 5, 2024, sent to the Office of Professional
Responsibility and the Office of Information Policy, requesting:

> Records and / or communications about any investigations, inquiries,
> or referrals concerning potential misconduct of any person working
> for Special Counsel Jack Smith’s office.

The Biden Justice Department requested a clarification in January. But
Judicial Watch has received no other communication since.

In December 2024, it was reported
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34870&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly90aGVoaWxsLmNvbS9ob21lbmV3cy9ob3VzZS81MDQ5MDc2LWp1c3RpY2UtZGVwYXJ0bWVudC1yZXZpZXctc3BlY2lhbC1jb3Vuc2VsLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=e5f5d645fd4c5ef283401d41daa27251a6e488d904fbb7d67f177580121e6289]
that the Justice Department’s Office of Professional Responsibility
had opened a review into whether Special Counsel Jack Smith’s team
skirted guidelines during their investigation into President-elect
Trump:

> Jay Bratt, a top prosecutor on the classified documents probe,
> previously noted complaints from an attorney representing one of
> Trump’s co-defendants.... Stanley Woodward, attorney for Trump
> valet Walt Nauta, accused Bratt of bringing up his interest in a
> judicial nomination as a pressure tactic.

Jack Smith and his team were a rogue political operation whose only
purpose was to keep Donald Trump from being elected. There were
serious complaints about misconduct by this get-Trump DOJ operation.
This new Justice Department must get on the ball and stop the secrecy
about the lawfare against President Trump.

We have several FOIA lawsuits related to the prosecutorial abuse
targeting Trump:

In March 2025, Georgia District Attorney Fani Willis was ordered
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34767&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYW50aS10cnVtcC1jb2xsdXNpb24tcmVjb3Jkcy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=7775b31bdd527fd4a3ed272c2df8968e6febe2f5c00f8e5a753b9431d67c4bad]
to turn
over 212 pages of records to a state court judge. The court also
ordered Willis to detail how the records were found and the reason for
withholding them from the public. The records were belatedly found in
response to our request and lawsuit for communications with Special
Counsel Jack Smith and the House January 6 Committee. Previously in
this case, in January 2025, the Superior Court in Fulton County, GA,
issued an order granting Judicial Watch $21,578 “attorney’s fees
and costs
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34871&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY291cnQtYXdhcmRzLWp1ZGljaWFsLXdhdGNoLTIxNTc4L10u4oCdP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=b7ab788cd2319e55a7fd7ebacb9edc0041ee32a1ff7b53686ba417da49f11065
Judicial Watch soon thereafter received payment.

In January 2024, we filed a
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=32351&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZmFuaS13aWxsaXMvXWxhd3N1aXQ/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=c5faa1a72d780496a35c6897937a690e1d1ffee7cbb6c11a16ad267d2c7ed2bf
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=31256&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZmFuaS13aWxsaXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=a177133761ceeb6142d7a7105a553c927c14ff9ff19081c7333752838044e9e1]
against Fulton County,
Georgia, for records regarding the hiring of Nathan Wade as a special
prosecutor by Willis. Wade was hired to pursue unprecedented criminal
investigations and prosecutions against former President Trump and
others over the 2020 election disputes.

In January 2025, a federal court in a separate case ordered
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34438&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvamFjay1zbWl0aHMtZmFuaS13aWxsaXMtY29tbXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=8900ebe1a100734cba60d89bdc12dda4475876f2fccdd4214207ce33a23ba16c]
the
Justice Department to provide information on communications between
Smith and Willis regarding the prosecution of then-former President
Donald Trump. The Justice Department had continued to object to
providing any information, even after its prosecutions against Trump
were shut down.

In February 2024, the Justice Department asked
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=31981&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmFtZXMtb2YtdG9wLXN0YWZmLWFudGktdHJ1bXAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=f983bb930d170366a97627dca8c343257ec206b62fce008c7bee21f62e8ad904]
a
federal court to allow the agency to keep secret the names of top
staffers working in Smith’s office that is targeting former
President Donald Trump and other Americans.

(Before his appointment to investigate and prosecute Trump, Smith
previously was at the center of several controversial issues, the IRS
scandal
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=28485&F=T&&hash=7d304403d871da9d079a66ed9ab4db4e2cf362db0486ad344a7df1a16d0ee34a]
among them. In 2014, a Judicial Watch investigation
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=28716&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctZ3VpZGUtdG8tY29uZ3Jlc3Npb25hbC1pbnZlc3RpZ2F0aW9ucy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=3cb9ceabc2b051a3443b24c8ce0623fb5229f954135b4a914b33c6f71413008e]
revealed that top IRS officials had been in communication with
Smith’s then-Public Integrity Section about a plan to launch
criminal investigations into conservative tax-exempt groups. Read more
here
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=28702&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYWJjcy1pcnMtbWVzcy1qdXN0aWNlLWRlcHQtdGFpbnRlZC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=9ed8deea73b100efa959715399410668bbe1ab82033f763fc7deb8d74f0e300b].)

Through the New York Freedom of Information Law, in July 2023, we
received the engagement letter
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=29822&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYnJhZ2ctcGFpZC10by1zaHV0LWRvd24taG91c2UtanVkaWNpYXJ5LW92ZXJzaWdodC1pbnRvLWluZGljdG1lbnQtb2YtdHJ1bXAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=84b544e6263a0f71f3f8f1b286d5c03d9bd00d835f6d312ede7bc8e320ffe224]
showing New York County District Attorney Alvin L. Bragg paid $900 per
hour for partners and $500 per hour for associates to the Gibson, Dunn
& Crutcher law firm for the purpose of suing Rep. Jim Jordan (R-OH) in
an effort to shut down the House Judiciary Committee’s oversight
investigation into Bragg’s unprecedented indictment of then-former
President Donald Trump.

BIDEN’S DOG ALSO ATTACKED SECRET SERVICE EMPLOYEES WHEN HE WAS VP

We uncovered Secret Service documents through FOIA lawsuits
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=32750&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYmlkZW4tZG9nLWF0dGFja3MvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=1dfdb187518b0636d8917eded6c35742aaa1421d3f8b1facd4f5d62df16488d8]
that show the two
German Shepherd dogs Joe Biden owned while president, Major and
Commander, attacked two dozen Secret Service and White House
personnel.

Now Judicial Watch just uncovered 22 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34859&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2Rocy11c3NzLWJpZGVuLWRvZy1iaXRlcy1yZWNvcmRzLW1hcmNoLTIwMjUvXW9mP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=454969f101c64b15ef9e498abe5fa725b404097de0f88fd1aaaa46e1246e2b7c
records revealing that while Biden was vice president, his German
Shepherd, Champ, attacked his U.S. Secret Service protective detail.
We received the documents in a June 18, 2024, FOIA request to the U.S.
Department of Homeland Security for:

> Any and all records related to incidents of aggression and bites
> involving the now-deceased Biden family dog, “Champ,” including
> but not limited to communications sent to and from USSS [United
> State Secret Service] officials in the Uniformed and Non-Uniformed
> Divisions involved in White House operations, the Vice Presidential
> Protective Detail, and the Presidential Protection Division.

In a March 24, 2012, email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34860&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2Rocy11c3NzLWJpZGVuLWRvZy1iaXRlcy1yZWNvcmRzLW1hcmNoLTIwMjUtcGdzLTktMTAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=fa473b717a843d36ab4d3d363ac7b7a7b6d8ec0b929c0c3a425ab015f4e6e497]
with the subject “Dog attack!!,” an employee writes: “I need a
couple of days off! Champ just tried to attack me!” Later in the
exchange the employee responds to the assistant to the special agent
in charge, “I need hazard pay!!”

On September 1, 2015, a special agent in the Vice Presidential
Protective Division reports
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34861&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2Rocy11c3NzLWJpZGVuLWRvZy1iaXRlcy1yZWNvcmRzLW1hcmNoLTIwMjUtcGdzLTEyLTEzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=74a851fb78f7f39c754f6deca1613986891e4bd3bafcb433d4ddd961da493a22]
a bite on the forearm, requiring a torn jacket to be repaired, and
notes that an attack by Champ had occurred on each of the prior three
days:

> Fyi, NEA [possibly North East Annex] is going to take the jacket and
> try to fix it, or will send it to their tailor.
>
> I will get it when they are done.

Another agent writes about the incident to colleagues under the
subject “Champ,” noting:

> When I went over to the Res [VP Residence] tonight to check on
> [redacted], I informed [redacted] of the incident (since the
> MilAides [military aides], Docs and VPCROs are outside with us when
> Champ is around).
>
> He said that Champ bit his forearm. The bite did not go thru his
> jacket but there were teeth indentations on his skin. There was no
> blood nor was the skin broken. He was check [sic] out by the Doc. AT
> [redacted] and [redacted] were notified. He still has marks on his
> skin today.
>
> This just a FYI since you were going to brief the SAIC/DSAIC
> [special agent in charge/deputy special agent in charge] tomorrow.
> That’s three incidents in the past three days (including the one I
> briefed you on regarding [redacted] at the Lake House on Sunday).

A separate September 1, 2015, exchange
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34862&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2Rocy11c3NzLWJpZGVuLWRvZy1iaXRlcy1yZWNvcmRzLW1hcmNoLTIwMjUtcGdzLTE1LTE2Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=d3d8e9db0a7b7eff1602177a1924b02c34e9d592364cd9561d6e6f2e8d852ba3]
between two Vice Presidential Division agents discusses recent
incidents with Champ “So it’s been twice this week that Champ has
snapped at someone on the shift. He came at me last week when I was on
midnights, but I said his name which calmed him down before he could
bite.”

A March 25, 2011, email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34863&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2Rocy11c3NzLWJpZGVuLWRvZy1iaXRlcy1yZWNvcmRzLW1hcmNoLTIwMjUtcGctMy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=f64df61f576a439fad826f54722199476dca71135bb1fbb617d6a5b5a8a13226]
from a lieutenant in the Uniformed Division, Vice Presidential Detail,
alerts colleagues:

> Yesterday two [redacted] sections officers observed the family pet
> – “Champ”– German Sheppard becoming more aggressive towards
> people, especially when the Labradoddle [sic] – “Brother” is
> around.
>
> Today, “Champ” showed aggression towards a grounds worker. The
> CP [command post] put out a broadcast for all personnel to avoid
> playing with or interacting with the family pets.
>
> Please make your personnel aware of this issue, and advise the CP to
> broadcast when the family pets are out on the grounds for the safety
> of the officers.”

On March 25, 2011, an email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=73081&L=34864&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2Rocy11c3NzLWJpZGVuLWRvZy1iaXRlcy1yZWNvcmRzLW1hcmNoLTIwMjUtcGctNC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=11842a186c87bd0170557b989193187e1d6243343b7cec76dd3ebe7549b996f2]
was sent warning that Champ had “been aggressively approaching and
chasing our Uniformed Division officers:”

> I just received a call from Inspector [redacted] reporting Champ has
> been aggressively approaching and chasing out Uniformed Division
> officers at night. Apparently, this has been a repetitive behavior
> over the past few nights.
>
> Do you have any suggestions on how we can resolve this situation? We

Judicial Watch just filed a FOIA lawsuit [] against the Justice Department for details of any investigations, inquiries, or referrals concerning potential misconduct of any person working for Special Counsel Jack Smith (Judicial Watch Inc. v U.S. Department of Justice [] (No. 1:25-cv-00801)). We sued after the Justice Department failed to respond to two FOIA requests on December 5, 2024, sent to the Office of Professional Responsibility and the Office of Information Policy, requesting: Records and / or communications about any investigations, inquiries, or referrals concerning potential misconduct of any person working for Special Counsel Jack Smith’s office. The Biden Justice Department requested a clarification in January. But Judicial Watch has received no other communication since. In December 2024, it was reported [] that the Justice Department’s Office of Professional Responsibility had opened a review into whether Special Counsel Jack Smith’s team skirted guidelines during their investigation into President-elect Trump: Jay Bratt, a top prosecutor on the classified documents probe, previously noted complaints from an attorney representing one of Trump’s co-defendants.... Stanley Woodward, attorney for Trump valet Walt Nauta, accused Bratt of bringing up his interest in a judicial nomination as a pressure tactic. Jack Smith and his team were a rogue political operation whose only purpose was to keep Donald Trump from being elected. There were serious complaints about misconduct by this get-Trump DOJ operation. This new Justice Department must get on the ball and stop the secrecy about the lawfare against President Trump. We have several FOIA lawsuits related to the prosecutorial abuse targeting Trump: In March 2025, Georgia District Attorney Fani Willis was ordered [] to turn over 212 pages of records to a state court judge. The court also ordered Willis to detail how the records were found and the reason for withholding them from the public. The records were belatedly found in response to our request and lawsuit for communications with Special Counsel Jack Smith and the House January 6 Committee. Previously in this case, in January 2025, the Superior Court in Fulton County, GA, issued an order granting Judicial Watch $21,578 “attorney’s fees and costs [ Judicial Watch soon thereafter received payment. In January 2024, we filed a [ [] against Fulton County, Georgia, for records regarding the hiring of Nathan Wade as a special prosecutor by Willis. Wade was hired to pursue unprecedented criminal investigations and prosecutions against former President Trump and others over the 2020 election disputes. In January 2025, a federal court in a separate case ordered [] the Justice Department to provide information on communications between Smith and Willis regarding the prosecution of then-former President Donald Trump. The Justice Department had continued to object to providing any information, even after its prosecutions against Trump were shut down. In February 2024, the Justice Department asked [] a federal court to allow the agency to keep secret the names of top staffers working in Smith’s office that is targeting former President Donald Trump and other Americans. (Before his appointment to investigate and prosecute Trump, Smith previously was at the center of several controversial issues, the IRS scandal [] among them. In 2014, a Judicial Watch investigation [] revealed that top IRS officials had been in communication with Smith’s then-Public Integrity Section about a plan to launch criminal investigations into conservative tax-exempt groups. Read more here [].) Through the New York Freedom of Information Law, in July 2023, we received the engagement letter [] showing New York County District Attorney Alvin L. Bragg paid $900 per hour for partners and $500 per hour for associates to the Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher law firm for the purpose of suing Rep. Jim Jordan (R-OH) in an effort to shut down the House Judiciary Committee’s oversight investigation into Bragg’s unprecedented indictment of then-former President Donald Trump. BIDEN’S DOG ALSO ATTACKED SECRET SERVICE EMPLOYEES WHEN HE WAS VP We uncovered Secret Service documents through FOIA lawsuits [] that show the two German Shepherd dogs Joe Biden owned while president, Major and Commander, attacked two dozen Secret Service and White House personnel. Now Judicial Watch just uncovered 22 pages [ records revealing that while Biden was vice president, his German Shepherd, Champ, attacked his U.S. Secret Service protective detail. We received the documents in a June 18, 2024, FOIA request to the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for: Any and all records related to incidents of aggression and bites involving the now-deceased Biden family dog, “Champ,” including but not limited to communications sent to and from USSS [United State Secret Service] officials in the Uniformed and Non-Uniformed Divisions involved in White House operations, the Vice Presidential Protective Detail, and the Presidential Protection Division. In a March 24, 2012, email [] with the subject “Dog attack!!,” an employee writes: “I need a couple of days off! Champ just tried to attack me!” Later in the exchange the employee responds to the assistant to the special agent in charge, “I need hazard pay!!” On September 1, 2015, a special agent in the Vice Presidential Protective Division reports [] a bite on the forearm, requiring a torn jacket to be repaired, and notes that an attack by Champ had occurred on each of the prior three days: Fyi, NEA [possibly North East Annex] is going to take the jacket and try to fix it, or will send it to their tailor. I will get it when they are done. Another agent writes about the incident to colleagues under the subject “Champ,” noting: When I went over to the Res [VP Residence] tonight to check on [redacted], I informed [redacted] of the incident (since the MilAides [military aides], Docs and VPCROs are outside with us when Champ is around). He said that Champ bit his forearm. The bite did not go thru his jacket but there were teeth indentations on his skin. There was no blood nor was the skin broken. He was check [sic] out by the Doc. AT [redacted] and [redacted] were notified. He still has marks on his skin today. This just a FYI since you were going to brief the SAIC/DSAIC [special agent in charge/deputy special agent in charge] tomorrow. That’s three incidents in the past three days (including the one I briefed you on regarding [redacted] at the Lake House on Sunday). A separate September 1, 2015, exchange [] between two Vice Presidential Division agents discusses recent incidents with Champ “So it’s been twice this week that Champ has snapped at someone on the shift. He came at me last week when I was on midnights, but I said his name which calmed him down before he could bite.” A March 25, 2011, email [] from a lieutenant in the Uniformed Division, Vice Presidential Detail, alerts colleagues: Yesterday two [redacted] sections officers observed the family pet – “Champ”– German Sheppard becoming more aggressive towards people, especially when the Labradoddle [sic] – “Brother” is around. Today, “Champ” showed aggression towards a grounds worker. The CP [command post] put out a broadcast for all personnel to avoid playing with or interacting with the family pets. Please make your personnel aware of this issue, and advise the CP to broadcast when the family pets are out on the grounds for the safety of the officers.” On March 25, 2011, an email [] was sent warning that Champ had “been aggressively approaching and chasing our Uniformed Division officers:” I just received a call from Inspector [redacted] reporting Champ has been aggressively approaching and chasing out Uniformed Division officers at night. Apparently, this has been a repetitive behavior over the past few nights. Do you have any suggestions on how we can resolve this situation? We don’t want to have an officer bit or any harm to Champ. On March 26, 2011, an email exchange [] with the subject line “Family Pets,” warns that Champ “showed aggression” toward an agent and a civilian employee on two separate occasions: “Champ” is becoming more protective of the residence. He showed aggression to one of our officers today and a second time to a Greenway employee [redacted]. Sgt. [redacted] spoke with [redacted] (who is a [redacted]), and she will turn off the automatic doggy door for both dogs, which means she will have to let them out herself. Officers on their push are required to call post [redacted] to find out where the dogs are, if they are out, for avoidance. On May 11, 2011, a lieutenant on the Emergency Response Team writes [] that there had been “several incidents” recently where Champ had “shown aggression” toward members of the Secret Service Emergency Response Team: Men – [likely Joe Biden] has indicated that his dog Champ has had several incidents where he has shown aggression towards members of ERT [Emergency Response Team] when we are posted at the VPR [vice president’s residence]. [Redacted] realizes that we are trying to give him and Champ space while walking the grounds and appreciates the job we are doing for him. Effective immediately, if Champ comes your way, call his name and let him see you. [Redacted] believes this will help alleviate any future aggression issues. In the future, if you are having any issues performing your duties let me know about them. If the incidents with Champ continue to take place, let me know so we can find an alternative solution. No wonder the Secret Service is a mess. Biden’s dogs terrorized agents and White House personnel for a decade, and nothing was done about it until we exposed the dangerous scandal. In June 2024, we uncovered [] Secret Service records that revealed the details about several incidents in which Secret Service personnel were bitten by then-President Biden’s dog Commander, sometimes requiring medical attention. Our FOIA requests and lawsuits [] exposed initial White House falsehoods about the severity and number of attacks by the Bidens’ previous dog, Major. Judicial Watch then received a tip that Commander was also attacking [] Secret Service personnel and uncovered documents last July showing 10 biting incidents. According to a Judicial Watch source, President Biden mistreated his dogs. The source disclosed that Biden punched and kicked his dogs. In February 2024, we received [] records related to incidents of aggression by Commander, including at least 23 biting incidents. After one incident, East Wing public tours were stopped for approximately 20 minutes due to the blood on the floor. These records include a spreadsheet [] of 22 incident reports between October 2022 and June 2023, 10 of which required medical treatment. JUDICIAL WATCH BATTLES FOR ELECTION INTEGRITY Micah Morrison, our chief investigative correspondent, summarizes [] our work to ensure fair elections across the country. Democracy by its nature is a messy business and the fight for clean and honest elections never ends. Judicial Watch has risen to the vanguard of voting integrity and voter rights reform with legal actions that include endingdiscriminatory elections in Hawaii [], stopping extreme partisan gerrymandering in Maryland [], and cleaning four million and counting dirty names [] from voter rolls around the country. And there’s more to come. In recent weeks, Judicial Watch notched three significant election integrity wins. In Mississippi, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit sided with Judicial Watch, declining to revisit an earlier ruling that it was unlawful for the state to count ballots arriving after Election Day. In California, Judicial Watch filed a federal lawsuit to prevent state officials from extending Election Day for seven additional days. And in Maryland, following a separate Judicial Watch court victory opening voter rolls to public scrutiny, a federal judge struck down a state board of elections regulation criminalizing the use of voter registration lists for election integrity investigations. This week, as well, President Trump signaled his support for election integrity action with a sweeping executive order [] that reinforces “a uniform Election Day across the nation,” requires “documentary proof of United States citizenship” to vote, and directs the attorney general to increase efforts to ensure state compliance with the National Voter Registration Act. In the Mississippi case siding with Judicial Watch, the full Fifth Circuit court let stand an appellate panel ruling that ballots arriving after Election Day cannot be counted. The appellate panel had ruled [] that “Congress statutorily designated a singular ‘day for the election’ of members of Congress and the appointment of presidential electors. Text, precedent, and historical practice confirm that this ‘day for the election’ is the day by which ballots must be both cast by voters and received by state officials.” Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton hailed the full Fifth Circuit action as “a historic victory for honest elections,” noting that federal law “sets ‘Election Day’ not ‘Election Week.’” Judicial Watch’s new lawsuit against California counting ballots up to seven days after Election Day “has even more urgency and strength,” Tom noted. In the California case, Judicial Watch filed a lawsuit [] on behalf of U.S. Representative Darrell Issa to prevent state election officials from extending Election Day for seven days beyond the date established by federal law. “Despite Congress’ unambiguous and longstanding statement regarding a single and uniform national Election Day,” the JW brief said, “California modified and extended Election Day by allowing seven additional days after Election Day for receipt of vote-by-mail ballots.” The lawsuit notes that late-arriving ballots can “change electoral outcomes in California.” Two of Issa’s Republican colleagues were leading on Election Night 2024 “but ultimately lost reelection due to late-arriving [vote-by-mail] ballots.” Issa called on the state to fix its “broken systems of elections.” In California, he told Breitbart [], “Election Day has become Election Month and ballots are counted until Democrats are declared the winner.” In the Maryland case, the National Voter Registration Act—a key weapon in Judicial Watch’s legal arsenal of electoral reform—was under attack. The NVRA directs the states to make “a reasonable effort” to remove from voting rolls the names of ineligible voters disqualified from voting due to death or change of residence. Dirty voter rolls—rolls that carry many ineligible voters—create opportunities for election fraud. Judicial Watch fought hard and ultimately won a legal battle [] to make Maryland voter rolls more transparent. But the Maryland State Board of Elections fought back, issuing a regulation that sought to criminalize the use of voter registration lists for investigations into NVRA violations. Judicial Watch filed a friend of the court brief [] in the case noting its extensive role in the Maryland NVRA litigation. Earlier this month, a federal judge in Maryland struck down [] the Board of Elections regulation. The court concluded that, “as a matter of law,” the regulation “presents an obstacle to accomplishing and executing the purposes and objectives of the NVRA.” The Maryland case is a win for transparency and accountability, a win that may echo across other states. “This new federal court ruling affirming transparency requirements for voter registration lists is an important victory for Maryland voters and election integrity,” Tom Fitton said. “It was truly outrageous that Maryland election officials tried to criminalize voters asking questions about election integrity.” Until next week, [Contribute] [] [advertisement] [] [32x32x1] [] [32x32x2] [] [32x32x3] [] [32x32x3] [] Judicial Watch, Inc. 425 3rd St Sw Ste 800 Washington, DC 20024 202.646.5172 © 2017 - 2025, All Rights Reserved Manage Email Subscriptions [] |

body:
Peter,

We're now seeing the consequences firsthand of having radical, leftist federal judges...
* _An Obama judge just blocked a major part of President Trump 's immigration policy_

* _A Biden judge issued a "temporary restraining order" against DOGE_

* _A Clinton judge blocked President Trump from firing executive branch employees_

When Democrats can't win at the ballot box, they resort to legislating from the courts!

Republicans will do everything in our power to **[FIGHT BACK](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/2kDEFkTG-UrNVjTJ1U45yqLIxxwWhlSVdrGMXgRTQkmH2DCPgAplsMy2y-0POhNBLsyxlpfPcmvbiNrksXgai_tSVt_Mm4IkX-sGXCVq1gOxPw-LrwzZcQrXlqXEgjO5kEHlyp8qxP3KW9EUkGg-lcaw7jLKXiVlBP-xubtEblZW2eLjXkAFXvVOTQ0NM-EmZeoNZv7--uLPlQrWnUC1Gj4Cjj3bLe7BK_pX3Yuygjsqre-_WDa3DzqxDVwpQiqQyx9kABsd0F0zAJTucs0skBKJrNQLyZNMDTpMx1L7KHcthIboaqIoOQS9zhCJ-CQf8vylQG8NNdcnQ0CWb6zJ7M32UopUvCNuzOfjVuAr_IR0zDmzp0D8Ai66EIi63jGvBMP4tHMXq4XRp8r7mSi0SE53Lzdn8APi3rpceh_iiH8cSMvwhASEIXEPlj4xpCPCnAuHoNPuq9SM-FwRorLnkffYIBJIZISR4KRfVUCtMPX9ZnjA7dOwjk62R-ggINihRyWcstWIELIKWXlmqUg84nbAFZKum3OFa4jUmcojHPhljv2DBX-Vwm2nHk1RS3jPR1LSvbzkrhs5KogZTBow0x8r7lyU3SRXWv7SWMEN_ASGjUY2QSLnxpJYI5sNvDZgrycSuuO3SF5EP5kEIcOpQXrltfOSJqV92nII2X-IUExje1hCiSqnL7_Yx3I61dHcz_55-ho9E9VCGPql2Q/GRg7rrRlE7D__BHysD9FGFmOKyaAcocP/7)** against this blatant overreach.

**[Our Senate GOP Majority must spend the coming years reshaping the federal judiciary by confirming as many new conservative judges nominated by President Trump as humanly possible!](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/YuvJp187ExjePe9WnIc0b0cjFBhMdwWDgccFvUn1C8HgSzTlshBTSAVzKfNoxjGxubhFHVjieyCyfo6jg1Op9klGCleY4vSSZjSRsQiA7CHb27QpcjbvZIX8L-1y_nIK_EgiycXifh4JQKfGeOOmn5NDS4Ik3vr5oZNU1ie7aJqOTyJlmT7N9g6alLvNJ0JOt0BqErJ532gvn2G0MKQS_fzoAouKQuXnr78OGLBlZ5cazwvavey7ywou_VOLe8gE1OTfDIgx3iKn4Z-HfNBN2L_IunVJE4Belxm_017EvdFg4NdCs4_-upHJkW95Wyr5NpDWuW2nI_1rPuL2LXkFw_2IOWlxXeqVkJKZA3vqyre73AQ9q0RcvRHtiXq2ieyo7aYUZXMNqBTpaCl-fS8-xel-lGLDUN1DrpE0_fkSw4scpv9RQx1e596rcgDQF-jJKMmZlVumh_WEEFX5zqGzK6T8SVQAl75YBgoxNMsRY-HdvRryzhv4tdPxkMsKmoIeJ-HWHq6pmWXulqbvKpkbKlRDif-IVO_GuWWCTnTtIPrcwPZCuMTnzgYE1PfjxJ9CrJN_iD0PpAVwPmqDXRFa4rLplzm2wEYJyuMjkBakDbJ9nIRMCJlHQfBlibGvheCICeJhbiA5HymdKjmIaLGbN_IeefvJAX1Q-X_aBHnVkyFYSr4QngKXsO28TlT3Ow5d-MtHYdXnjnzT5Gscyg/pmMatm-7gWNTwpHA6fjcTJbBG2TAGfSp/7)**

body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zlmf5cq2e4rh6j3qaohsfkb04uq54p4ael9pv7v8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm4ob1cjh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. name: Sarah McAbee, Stand in the Gap
subject: Trump Pardons J6ers… Now what?
body:
First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

| | |
---
| | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqgj8d2kcgnh4s8aksejfddpecept7q5sioak5qg_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm4ob1c1h2bs) Friend,

First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

Even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers...

**I work directly with many of the J6ers. And here are some of the issues they face: Some are homeless to this day. Some can’t get a job because of the time they’ve spent in jail. And many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life.**

They have had their rights stripped from them. Many have been separated from their families for years. They can’t vote. They can’t own a firearm.

Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions.

_And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights._

So, what comes next for J6ers?

There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. That’s exactly what Stand in the Gap is helping them do.

[Friend, as a personal favor to me, can you please send an urgent donation of $10 or more to support Stand in the Gap? I am hoping to get 100 new supporters to help us in our mission to rebuild the lives of J6ers who need us now more than ever.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl14rusisb6qhedj6l1nfvuq9j1a3ga8gcpob380_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm4ob1c1h2bs)
[Donate](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zas5f42aqfp4geen36n41j2hv5vqr3opbrvtrcho_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm4ob1c1h2bs)
Stand in the Gap originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is helping the recently released J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated.

One of the simplest ways we are helping them is by providing them with insurance and the resources to meet their healthcare needs.

Many of the J6ers haven’t seen a dentist or doctor in four years. They’ve lost their jobs, which means they’ve lost their insurance.

Our mission is to ensure that every J6er not only has access to healthcare to meet all of their medical needs but also receives the help they need to heal mentally, emotionally, and financially.

[Please consider donating $10, $35, $50, $100, or any amount you can generously afford today. >>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zh6s3sjk3brtnbc7i1j7suqnvupmrv16cn8k0ji0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm4ob1c1h2bs)
[Donate](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmaqvook8r8mtf6rjfmbh9frq9qg887fmn8ijpg8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm4ob1c1h2bs)
Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not.

We were founded to “stand in the gap” for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. Our primary aim is to let them know that they are not forgotten. This begins by providing health insurance to meet immediate physical needs and evolves as Stand In The Gap is the one-stop shop for any J6er in need of counseling as they reintegrate back into society.

The J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers, and It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity.

[If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me today by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand In The Gap provide healthcare and counseling to our J6 community.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl185ef4amu8nqua8tqffh9a34job9gr6sbtlvdo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm4ob1c1h2bs)

Sincerely,

Sarah McAbee
Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer, Stand in the Gap

subject: the enemy within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0rd9vr7ol2mkqualqg89vr5usrmvri9bapnaas8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm6o34cph2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7oqt1cok5dt1mpm1ume3uo7k5o51ri44f3j0n8o_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm6o34cph2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,

David Horowitz

name: Sarah McAbee, Stand in the Gap
subject: Trump Pardons J6ers… Now what?
body:
First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

| | |
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcapgaefhnlb28ltu7nhe8ejcmbo5nfksvedf9ro_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gmeo72clh2bs) Friend,

First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

Even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers...

**I work directly with many of the J6ers. And here are some of the issues they face: Some are homeless to this day. Some can’t get a job because of the time they’ve spent in jail. And many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life.**

They have had their rights stripped from them. Many have been separated from their families for years. They can’t vote. They can’t own a firearm.

Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions.

_And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights._

So, what comes next for J6ers?

There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. That’s exactly what Stand in the Gap is helping them do.

[Friend, as a personal favor to me, can you please send an urgent donation of $10 or more to support Stand in the Gap? I am hoping to get 100 new supporters to help us in our mission to rebuild the lives of J6ers who need us now more than ever.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrook1gs0fp7c2tp7jd1vpmqfpgmeo1tlchu8djo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gmeo72clh2bs)
[Donate](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zocl43lnop5nv34klfs272bt8rhlffhivema3hk0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gmeo72clh2bs)
Stand in the Gap originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is helping the recently released J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated.

One of the simplest ways we are helping them is by providing them with insurance and the resources to meet their healthcare needs.

Many of the J6ers haven’t seen a dentist or doctor in four years. They’ve lost their jobs, which means they’ve lost their insurance.

Our mission is to ensure that every J6er not only has access to healthcare to meet all of their medical needs but also receives the help they need to heal mentally, emotionally, and financially.

[Please consider donating $10, $35, $50, $100, or any amount you can generously afford today. >>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zreu3ff7jka1nvqe91r0g9dracr8d3hcales1muo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gmeo72clh2bs)
[Donate](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zau1d0p0uk4vaoh46q3lp7qmlaun8k0e1bt6oljo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gmeo72clh2bs)
Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not.

We were founded to “stand in the gap” for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. Our primary aim is to let them know that they are not forgotten. This begins by providing health insurance to meet immediate physical needs and evolves as Stand In The Gap is the one-stop shop for any J6er in need of counseling as they reintegrate back into society.

The J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers, and It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity.

[If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me today by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand In The Gap provide healthcare and counseling to our J6 community.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z66dhl95qinb26skj7h4966dqd7r6ttvoatb5c30_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gmeo72clh2bs)

Sincerely,

Sarah McAbee
Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer, Stand in the Gap

body:

[Click here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-e-chthrut-didthutlhu-ju/) [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-r/) **March 28, 2025****FOUR DAYS LEFT TO SAVE WISCONSIN AND AMERICA!** In just four short days, Wisconsin has the opportunity to save Wisconsin by electing Judge Brad Schimel and Brittany Kinser and enshrining Voter ID into the Constitution. We must finish strong.Last weekend, **President Donald J. Trump endorsed Brad Schimel** and encouraged voters to **VOTE EARLY**. We need to bank every vote before Election Day to ensure victory for Judge Schimel! Make a plan to vote, then tell your family and friends to vote. Go to _[myvote.wi.gov](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-y/)_. This election is critical. The only poll that matters is the one on Election night!Following the 2024 election, WisGOP maintained field staff, maintained minority engagement staff and offices, and built on the Farm Team local government initiative, which has included over 150 local candidates in 2025. Additionally, the WisGOP released 3 radio ads and 2 newspaper ads for Black and Hispanic engagement, increased digital efforts to encourage voters to VOTE EARLY, and kept the pressure on Susan Crawford and Jill Underly through social and earned media. These unprecedented investments show WisGOP's commitment to providing a strong infrastructure for Republican candidates up and down the ballot!-Team WisGOP **In Case You Missed It**[**Pure Gold: Crawford Doubles Down on Gerrymandering Congressional Maps**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-j/)
In recent weeks, Democrats and Susan Crawford have really pushed their luck. Wisconsin voters know that a vote for Susan Crawford is a vote for a dangerously liberal agenda and even a vote to disenfranchise voters of Wisconsin's 1st and 3rd Congressional Districts.[**Fact Check: Mark Pocan misses the mark on Crawford and Schimel record**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-t/)
In case you missed it, Democrats continue to lie about Brad Schimel and Susan Crawford's record; we're setting the record straight.[**Tampon Tim Stumps for Susan Crawford after he labeled 1.7 million Wisconsin voters Nazis**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-i/)
Ahead of Tampon Tim's visit to Wisconsin to stump for Susan Crawford, we thought Wisconsinites would like a refresher on what Walz thinks of Wisconsinites. It's no secret why Walz is here supporting Dangerously Liberal Democrat Susan Crawford; they are both dangerously liberal and wrong for Wisconsin.[**Walz and Crawford: A Dangerous Alliance for Wisconsin 's Future**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-d/)
Tim Walz's visit to Wisconsin in support of Susan Crawford comes as no surprise--both champion the same far-left agenda. His presence solidifies Crawford's disconnect from the needs of everyday Wisconsinites, particularly regarding her extreme stance on illegal immigration.[**WisGOP announces NEW website to highlight Jill Underly 's failures**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-h/)
WisGOP launched a new site, DrJillUnderly.com, showcasing Jill Underly's abysmal record of failing Wisconsin's children and families.[**WisGOP Launches First of Three Minority Outreach Radio Ads**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-k/)
The Republican Party of Wisconsin is gearing up for the final stretch of the election by launching the first of three radio ads focused on minority outreach. The first ad will appear in the Milwaukee media market, highlighting Jill Underly's abysmal record with the Department of Public Instruction. The first ad, "12 Percent," will begin airing today.[**WisGOP Hispanic Outreach Office Vandalized**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-u/)
Windows at the WisGOP Hispanic Outreach Office on the south side of Milwaukee were smashed. A police report was filed this morning.**[President Donald J. Trump endorses Judge Brad Schimel](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-o/)**
President Donald J. Trump endorsed Judge Brad Schimel for Wisconsin's Supreme Court.[**Watch out for this weekend 's lineup: Susan Crawford, Mandela Barnes, & Jon Lovett!**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-b/)
[In case you missed it, WisDems and Susan Crawford are doubling down on far-left causes this weekend with the help of Jon Lovett and Mandela Barnes. In the newest ad, Crawford's support for dangerously liberal interests is reaffirmed by her strongest advocates, who support gender-mutilation surgery for minors, boys in girls' sports, and providing puberty blockers to children without parental consent.](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-a/)[**WisGOP Calls out Liberal Court Majority for Playing Politics**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-f/)
Today is a great day to ask Susan Crawford and her Democrat cronies why they are fear-mongering voters and playing politics with a decision her liberal friends could have addressed months ago. In fact the Wisconsin Supreme Court heard oral arguments on abortion law on November 12, 2024. The liberal politicians on the Court have had over 130 days to address the issue. Yet, they chose to keep it on the table for Crawford.[**Crawford Hates Commonsense Pro-America Agenda**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-z/)
Judge Brad Schimel has secured the endorsement of President Donald J. Trump and the Democrats are doubling down on attacking his America-First Agenda. Crawford's attacks on Schimel and the Trump Administration are nothing but an attack on commonsense and putting Wisconsinites, and Americans first.[**WisGOP Statement on Obama Endorsing Madison Liberal Susan Crawford**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-v/)
"A vote for Susan Crawford is a vote for a Dangerously Liberal Democrat agenda. Nearly 80% of Crawford's donations came from out-of-state liberals, just like her endorsement. Wisconsin voters are already running up the score for Brad Schimel to protect normalcy."**[ICYMI: Hakeem Jeffries says quiet part out loud, Crawford Victory = gerrymandering maps](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-e/)**
The Democrat Party Leader, Hakeem Jeffries confirmed that a vote for Susan Crawford is a vote for a dangerously liberal agenda to rip up Congressional maps and remove Congressman Steil and Van Orden's House Seats, blatantly ignoring the will of Wisconsin voters.[**WisGOP Announces RECORD Number of Election Observer Shifts for April 1st**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-s/)
The Republican Party of Wisconsin's Election Integrity Team is fully prepared for Election Day. Over 2,400 Election Observer shifts are already scheduled for the Spring General Election on April 1st, with more being added daily. This is a record for Republican Election Observers in a Spring General Election.**[Allowing Boys in Girls Sports? Not Alerting Parents to Name Changes? Crawford wouldn't protect Wisconsin Parents](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-chthrut-didthutlhu-g/)**
Susan Crawford is a DANGEROUS Madison Democrat who is aligned with the most far-left groups around. From using Dane County Liberals who defy ICE to tying herself at the hip to groups that vehemently oppose parental rights and protecting girls' sports, Crawford is wrong for Wisconsin.

# _Weekly Update_
As I think about the past week of the legislative session, I am in awe of all of the people who are driving change by ensuring their voices are heard in our Statehouse.

This past Tuesday, we held our inaugural Divine 9 Day where members from Black Greek Letter Organizations organized together in the Statehouse to advocate for our communities. _You can read more about Divine 9 Day further in the newsletter_.

Additionally, members of the Indy Black Chamber of Commerce came together in the Statehouse to learn about legislation and to find out how they can get involved. Finally, we held a panel focused on the topic, "The Economic Effects of Dismantling DEI and How Businesses Can Move Forward."

Lastly, in Utilities Committee this week, we heard moving testimony from constituents all over our state expressing concerns about HB 1007 and how it will impact Hoosier families. You can learn more about HB 1007 below. **Committees I Served on This Week: ** **[Tax and Fiscal Policy](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=2e1c5eb9d8da17f5c710002643009959e70817427bddcaf678951ad135e1e99d7efcc7cdb83bb4b419013749a96236c6cab1ef7be14efd07 "Tax and Fiscal Policy")

#
* * *
---
| | | |
---
| | I join the many of you who have called, written and otherwise expressed concern about [HB 1007](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=2e1c5eb9d8da17f5cdea445d0e396268371efe26255a2f6390209c7722e3318c7704e0422e74cd53b8c10c7ecec14afa41a70320b2e53f45 "HB 1007").

I am proud that District 46, and all of Indiana for that matter, is home to major corporations that are driving innovation, stimulating our state's economy and providing jobs to Hoosiers.

We know that to continue attracting these types of corporations our energy grid needs to be able to support them, and that nuclear energy _could_ be a viable option down the line.

This is why I supported a bill that would approach small modular reactors (SMRs) in the form of a pilot program to mitigate risk to the pockets of ratepayers as well as real-world risks to our communities.

Unfortunately, **HB 1007 does not make those same considerations**.

This bill is a prime example of fiscal irresponsibility and is riddled with utility bill increases for Hoosier families.

Furthermore, this legislation expects the ratepayers to foot the bill for an experimental technology that has**yet to be successfully implemented anywhere in the country**.

Despite my concerns with the bill, I still made an effort to improve it in Utilities Committee this past week.

I introduced an amendment that would help Hoosiers with their energy bills by creating an income driven utility assistance program for families who qualify.

If we are asking Hoosiers fund nuclear research for large corporations, we ought to provide assistance for families who are already forced to choose between putting food on the table and keeping the lights on: **Senate Republicans did not support the amendment.**

This bill is now moving to our Tax and Fiscal Policy Committee. I am looking forward to another chance to look at the bill and will keep working to ensure we are being mindful of the realities of folks across this state who simply cannot afford to finance a project that could never come online.
**Want to learn more about HB 1007?**
[Click here for the bill page.](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=2e1c5eb9d8da17f530530d92536102d15fd0b95d53a4ff7d1d7a43916177ac5d6259f1baf53b53ea8a5b220762c8e65b2583f8666043153c "Click here for the bill page. ")

**Want to see the members of the Tax and Fiscal Committee and their contact information?**
[Click here for the committee page.](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?qs=2e1c5eb9d8da17f542506eb492f6f3d9319ee2d043c25ec12e586ad8b84b0e8ff043514530d71907b2571475d100566f55c3c919fe35a57d "Click here for the committee page. ")

* * *
---
# Divine 9 Day at the Indiana Statehouse
---
---
The Inaugural Divine 9 Day was so incredibly special, and it meant so much to me to see these historic organizations represented in our Statehouse.

It was an honor to host this event alongside Representatives Vanessa Summers, Carolyn Jackson, Vernon G. Smith, Alex Burton, as well as Senator Lonnie Randolph. Thank you all for your dedication to our communities.

This event left me with an both overwhelming feeling of gratitude for my sisters of Zeta Phi Beta Sorority and all of those who make up the Divine 9, as well as boundless hope for what we can achieve when we are united.

We are already planning for Divine 9 Day 2026 and cannot wait for the voices of the Brothers and Sisters of the Divine 9 to be amplified throughout the People's House once more.
---
#
* * *
---
# **March Meet-up at Mansion Society**
---
| | |
---
| | Thank you so much to everyone who took time out of their Friday morning to take an active role in your government and support a local business.

I was so glad to connect with so many of you at my March coffee meet up, and I am so grateful to Mansion Society for hosting.

There are so many issues that impact our Indianapolis community being discussed right now in your Statehouse. It is essential for us to work together to make sure our voices are heard: **this is how we create change**.

Stay tuned for my next coffee meet-up in May where I will be providing updates post-legislative session and breaking down how passed legislation impacts **you**.

body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvutv7eaam7n3u7ucl73qtqoee1utvv54ifbp3sg_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm9or5cth2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdp5i7hrn61u8f6t8o9dctv07c6nr80m41bp0dv0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c9gm9or5cth2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,

David Horowitz

If you ever want to review how we handle your data, feel free to contact us directly. Transparency is our priority, and we’re happy to address any questions you might have. By clicking the unsubscribe link, you’ll be taken to a page where you can either adjust your communication preferences (such as receiving fewer emails or only on specific topics) or completely remove yourself from our list. The process is straightforward, and any changes will take effect promptly. We don’t use tricks or gimmicks to keep you subscribed. Our priority is to ensure that our emails add value to your day, and if they don’t, we respect your decision to part ways. Accessibility and Communication If you have any trouble accessing the unsubscribe page, managing preferences, or understanding why you’re receiving this email, you can reach out directly to our support team at info@commonsense.org. We aim to provide a response within a reasonable time frame and address your concerns effectively. Our communication is designed to be as inclusive as possible, but we know there’s always room for improvement. If you have any feedback on how we can make our emails more accessible or relevant, please don’t hesitate to share. A Commitment to Non-Intrusive Emails We aim to create a non-intrusive communication experience. This means we won’t overwhelm your inbox with excessive messages, and we work hard to ensure our content remains clear and concise. The purpose of this email is to stay connected with you and provide updates or information that we believe is meaningful. If we ever fail to meet these standards, we encourage you to let us know. Feedback, whether positive or constructive, is always appreciated. Your thoughts help us understand how we can do better and improve our communication approach. While we cannot guarantee every suggestion will be implemented, we will take the time to carefully review and consider your input. Legal Information We comply with all applicable laws and regulations regarding email communication. This includes adhering to anti-spam laws and maintaining the highest standards for consent-based communication. Your trust matters, and we work diligently to ensure every email you receive meets these requirements. If you need further clarification on our compliance policies or legal obligations, please feel free to ask. Transparency and accountability are central to our communication strategy, and we’re happy to provide additional details if needed. A Final Note Emails are one of the many ways we stay connected, but we understand they aren’t perfect for everyone. If there’s another way you’d prefer to communicate or stay updated, let us know. Whether it’s through social media, a direct call, or another channel, we’re open to finding the most effective way to share information with you. We want to emphasize that our goal is never to disrupt or clutter your inbox. Every email sent is intended to provide value, and we genuinely appreciate your time and attention. Thank you for allowing us to stay in touch with you. This footer was designed to ensure transparency, provide essential information, and give you full control over your communication preferences. We hope it meets your expectations, but if there’s anything you’d like to see improved, we’re always here to listen.

| Peter,
I'm in Gloucester about to kick off this weekend's municipal candidate training, and I wanted to take a quick minute to check in with you.
Candidates across the state are all systems go with the support of the Massachusetts Republican Party.
But before I kick off today's candidate training, I have to humbly ask you for a donation to help fund some very important Conservative causes -
1. Special elections are coming up at lightning speed. Republicans have 2 pick up opportunities this spring, and we need your help to fund highly targeted voter outreach.
2. We've got incredible candidates running for municipal office across the state. Within minutes, we can identify & text absentee voters who haven't yet turned in their ballot to get them out to vote.
3. Massachusetts cannot afford another 4 years under a Governor Maura Healey! We must be prepared to support her replacement in 2026.

These efforts are key to Conservative gains this year and next. Our Chair, Amy Carnevale, and I are laser focused on strengthening the Republican Party and increasing our ranks. Are you on board?

## Major Earthquake Strikes Southeast Asia
A 7.7 magnitude earthquake [rocked Myanmar and neighboring Thailand](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFu6zAMRb_G3hxQJG05g4a3ZMtbOxqURMVqFDt11AT5-8LdO15c4BzgfJyns-SSl8t_uamraZ0QsO-AOjxOUXJ5T9xGl1RRqVVnLBMyMmI7OxCCIVAcwQZrvJFhTOQHDTyistg2u50GhEcDAAYO0dBo1VujYkYafMOgMdd1O3yueamzpvJen7odwnpri5trvT8a-tfgqcGT3Bd9PfZrH1vNoWiDpzpLLrLETmWr89e3XLXzslyu67XjFHS0EjRa9iYFCAkHSL7nniP11G4u3l-5lPwYbMNwuUkuv_L6V4ynw58AAAD__wszYB0) on Friday, killing at least 150 people and injuring more than 700, with the full extent of the damage still unclear. In Bangkok, officials said 10 people were killed and over 100 were missing from three construction sites after the quake, including an unfinished high-rise that collapsed to the ground. A dashcam captured [a video of the high-rise collapse.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDEPmzAQRn8NbI7s8wXw4KELW7p2RGd8BjcGU-wE5d9X6d7tkz7p6en9ekwPiinuy0_a2NaQJ5BwF1ILMJOnmD4Ttt4GZmDdslU9akBAgHa13qHhoI0jEyCguUuJ7BAZfN_1um-j_dKkBqOklErevNJDz65XTGrQnWtQso81n7ffOe515ZA--c3nbc5bm-xa61Ea_aOBsYGRjp2v8r0aGN_Rc25g9FTWmTYRcq60sChrvopwr5h83Bcx55ToKN9JRTjal2d-ijVW4T7iyBef4ZUE01nXPy96snChu6MZpMJZIpMyxjsNcvBy1jjPrj2tP66YUixd36BcNorpn279X763hb8BAAD__-b7csA)

Authorities are evacuating buildings and will be inspecting thousands of structures for damage in the coming days. Meanwhile, rescue teams are using [drones, sniffer dogs and diggers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FugzAQgOGnsbeg8_nAYfDQhS1dOyJjH3CVgQgsaN6-SvfOv_RJ_9ejfwTJsk6fYWFfxq1HwPoG9oZtn4LkV086-ZEZ2Wr2xpFFQkLUs28Hl7gBqFNbj1hHR5gw2NTGCBRp1OLfGlhsDQAYqJKxd8eDMxzM3TaDIuAkZdur703WMvOYX9vJexW3RWc_l_I8lP1Q2CnsruuqhiG-m8Ju5etQ2GU5WWEXaeIfMItb66J3n56X5CxH4xTBtATJf2L57_D0-BsAAP__wAtRfg) to search for signs of life amid the rubble.
## Trump Order Targets Federal Labor Unions
President Trump signed an executive order to end [collective bargaining with federal labor unions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwyAUhZ_G3rDgAv4ZGLp4S9eOFoYb51YYIiB28_ZVMnXpdnQ-6ejo-7osF0uB4vZpdzT1mhbgoBmXDKbFWwrPRbXeXBEBZYtGDEqCAgXQ3gyC0n4atfdW96sSXg8TeK55LxXnGlsyrzUuYRKcc8E7L-Q44DoItGKU_doojp5qyt13olhveA3PdGDuXNrbYG613ksjPxqYG5jP8-zi6iKe5cUbmNdHoYil_InshRuYa37sd1Zoi4XhD7pHpQNZyh4zw-iZSyGge5erzZulSHFjdsPoCAujeKRwIMsuWjGNvRjbbPz9pBCo9EOj-LZbCu-f9T9vh4HfAAAA___kenJb) in any agencies that have a national security role in the government. Unions at a wide array of agencies could be affected, including the Departments of State, Defense, Veterans Affairs, Energy, Health and Human Services, Treasury, Justice, Commerce, and parts of Homeland Security. In an unusual move, the Trump administration [preemptively filed for a declaratory judgment](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQRn-NvTmyzwbiwUMXtnTtiEw44CpjI3Okzb-vkr3zp-896X3dhlukRHn5jBsGnssAGhqlrQI_TJHSc3ByCjMioJUYTOcsOHAAcg3QdNa5BlyDJs7O39vZNt3Ve69NO6GVFF40bcEbrbXRl8nYa4djZzCaq21H4TROxKVevgtlXnFOz_LAermXTaawMu-HsB8CegE9r7hSSq9NQF9xOVNkKllAfy9nZTVG5oSHgL4B432rFddz29WZqWQ1xrpEypQXVWlZ-VCMv_FQ76-AXtYw7T-UEh1tJ5xetkhvmeT_wjwC_AUAAP__XX9lMg) in a Waco, Texas, court, approving the White House's authority to rescind or repudiate collective bargaining agreements.
## Dow Drops 700 Points in Broad Decline
Stocks dropped sharply on Friday, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average [down 715 points](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFvhSAUBeBfAxsGLvjQgaGL2-va0SBcn_ShGL3V-O8bu3c7yUm-k_P17J8-5bS8Pv2MjsbSg4RaSC2g7aNP-eoNj25EBNQcnbJGgwEDwCcXG7S2bocGNCJYCFi3aIKpwTxkE1qe3K1JDa2SUipZRaUbi4NV6FWjHwMzEmOislXfJS004ZivcuBWhTLz7CaidWf6g0HHoDvPswrLEO6SQXfTDDqp72wZdDuV8Baz395Igkr0l8jpQPGzRk-4VxPNmW8urmfKOe0Py4x8zT7lvzX67_3h4DcAAP__rH9aSg) as investors grapple with trade uncertainty and a new report showing that inflation ticked up again in February.

The market saw declines across all the major exchanges. The S&P 500 was down almost 2% and the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.7%. The Dow’s percentage decline was 1.69%.

One factor fueling Friday's selloff was the latest Personal Consumption Expenditures report, which showed [prices increasing more than expected](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGy2yAQRb9G6lazLMg8FxRp1L20KT1rsVjECBRg7NHfZ5w-_Z175pxf37dvjinmx0_exfVQboQ0A2qg681zTOfNjN4FERI9ilPWaDJkiMbN-TlYi3d7UcobdTX2Esy6elSitbkHGqP7vKGmq0JEhZNX-svK3Sph9aUv98Gg-NhLnX6XmPsmIZ3lJXVayz4mt_V-tEH_GGgZaAkxc15lOnkr5bMYaMnybgMtKb5koKX1sj5h5_qUDr14PsGXN_hajgYWEY4PpUE7YEaEzM3zH2gxP4EbvDklaL2KdKgiqUGoZYfONYYAMYfEPZYMQbg2IEQ080xm2vqexur88Y4pxXaxg8HHzjH9s-j_q_py9DcAAP__OKh62g) last month, rising 0.4% month over month and 2.8% year over year.

Analysts say another key factor is uncertainty over the impact and timing of new tariffs. Broad reciprocal tariffs are scheduled to be imposed on April 2.

body:
First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

| | |
---
| | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/dTSz9zrapi766BLErs-NlD_FlfimaMVLqkiW0XRJ1YZsSZjLbsN3LHZiIfK1t091nntT8WU0hk6WAETLcqhJ1g8D0N-vh1Sr7u-VHJvHAtoZBGHUZOWjl7o_OpdGuJ_iYz78D4TAHFPsy3KCb_ty58ciPa5MzjvDkwW4yrc2MQK6B0HJ6KOIxwC8QObYaLMsnYqXetwsollT1BRhmIp0XBMCbEfR4vRinUE_csm7nzOF6iCPWjFZSAUjsDLmScBUIIMQZBMcTR4oaQBXV3siW0qk9pF6yQCOTNM7MUlpXPWn-qDqdmReyxkhuAGmQsTzTY37Gmo6ikfFCKYVT4uYb1DONOg9/57z8gApEiUOqoIkrCDnDGMOPtu_BUdHE/7) Friend,

First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

Even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers...

**I work directly with many of the J6ers. And here are some of the issues they face: Some are homeless to this day. Some can’t get a job because of the time they’ve spent in jail. And many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life.**

They have had their rights stripped from them. Many have been separated from their families for years. They can’t vote. They can’t own a firearm.

Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions.

_And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights._

So, what comes next for J6ers?
