## Texas Health CEO Fired Over Spying
Superior HealthPlan CEO [Mark Sanders was fired](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGvozAQhH8NdBsZ44RQUFyT7l17ZbTYa7yKsZG98PL-_Yno2utWO6NPM_Pn6_mFHDktv3GlSd4-P7XSV1A96PHpkOPP07RumpUbu5ambjC9NrdODW2YutmYcTCDH-e5G-6okPw8dop87_urubU8nTDV67FT17u6X8w8d2Ovlb7frkQKG6PIseRykUBCb6w-_uSDysXmtY1TENlq0_9q9KPRj0Tf1VRMmCQnzqfn37fRj5gtxkY_AmGUAJzqXjBZAksZPBdygF6oALqVRTgtIBkCl_PaCh8oBJwOqsILSi711B0vsG_guAjgXoUTfGJCyHslsHk9YUTwogQbviUnmNG-lpL35MAGsq_alslt3xwj19vQGLWsyPHTUP47-THpvwEAAP__4KuKgg) Friday after state investigators accused the company of using taxpayer funds to hire private investigators to gather personal data on patients and lawmakers. During a House committee hearing on Wednesday, [Sanders claimed](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2u4yAUhJ8Gd1jH-JeCYht32XZL6xgODgoGC0gcv_0q6W5xu9GMNPNp_t2WGzrvwvYXd1LlbeMiQPQcWi7kYtD5a-kqo1YwsqlINWPXim5oYKzuCqbBNghyIqt7iWY1JK2kEUaLRIOunPqUQStkA_0EU92tayNbAWIaeiJA1gEZV2Kqy50KvTFbf8UXpVrHvfLqXsqRWfuHiZmJ-TzP-vHG8AmZmF14US5uw-JiyF8jPxMGTVzH_cBwcdT6mcnwaHk-Lhc2HgPXz1ziTilzj-eOj4-yqCnzLwHHUmIKdPGNAiX0_McQE3OVlDlO573Lw8g62HZ0_ktcfr3wpcT_AAAA__-RiXnF) the company relied only on public records, but emails showed the company had hired private investigators to dig into patients’ backgrounds. Centene Corporation, the parent company of Superior HealthPlan, expressed its disapproval of the actions taken by Sanders when they announced his dismissal. Lawmakers called the tactics a betrayal of trust during the hearing. [Here's a video from the session](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0UsGSpCoQ_Br6xgQWovbBw4s36232useOEkolBsGAsrvn7ze0Z2-7JzIyi4Qk-fVx-0AffJx_4ko9P6d0AwVGKi3henPow9etvrh-VO5aXaiv2lpD3VSqvSy9Q0caLY4aTU1VpauOwMJEkxtbGO3F94eZ0nCtlOlU91aPY3XVoKBrDJFCUStynlN-44WYnlim8JXulN9sWi-hX5i3IvR_AgYBw_NgBQyZNvbRUV5SYAFDYeS9CBiqqzJKd3BtGlCNMq0CoYdM061kK_Q7P44VjPnB00OAaf_nh8V1e1EPIqZ1JPetMOX1VP5m-xqZ8zkwWlN3jqyhyZLrOqW10U1dT9hW3QiKrGtH1zV_jkzx3Faqm4DmuN6eg9Dvr7RgjrzmSGxgiPQodcGIkVP06fUC3_wJQrIYTrQQBl6kj2XPGC1JS0lOPpOTODFliW71zD7OkpNcfD7Qlv0dmaSPdyrsZ-SUy6E7P8t9k85nlrgX9lGeBckl7YWkTethRiQ_KcoNn5yiHNF-zjnt0Um7kP0sl9y77eFD8KVpRa3mFX04u-V_frZ7D78DAAD__3Yd1Hg).
## Parole Denied for Selena's Killer
Yolanda Saldívar, [convicted of murdering](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2K3DAUBeCnkTuZqyv_Fiq8WdxtIIQkpbmW7syIyD-RtOPx2wenT3WKAwfO9-tj-iAf_Hr_Sgub_LptEwLWErTEfnLkwzlVhTMzuF4VbFRbaawaBW3xMGgJmtnW4Bj6RqG2te1JtZ0lTaBV4c01Bhp7BXUHXVnNs-o1AnZNzQwkKmDn8xbL_ODML0q3cG5PjqXdliKYR857EnoQOAocj-Mol7RencCRV_mZBI4rH1fY6BcWOCYOvJJM8rcPgaM8t0CrI5koOIH1Fy2wHt6fFKXj1bOTO8UtsNQgT6aYJN0yR5kj3b2Vy2d0HAWOFOUwqLdvf77_EHrcrHdCv79dcHyknxz3Ihq3Hz4En5pWVHBfyId_N_J_XZ8G_wYAAP__mF56UQ) Tejano music star Selena Quintanilla-Pérez in 1995, was denied parole Thursday, just days before the 30th anniversary of Selena’s death. Saldívar was removed as president of Selena's fan club and manager of Selena Etc. boutiques over [embezzlement allegations](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPozAUBOBfYzoj-9kQKFyQi-hy0jW30jbogR9grTHIJiH59yu233I00kjzfdy7OzrvwvQXFzL7a1w7EFBwoTjUnUXn353OrOmFrWVGRl60Al1Kcclmo0VZjSj6gmo9jn1NlZQ4UKkVQlkPfebMOSYU1FIUlahy3feyViCgKgsigUwLsm5fY77PtNML0-jf65NiPqxL5s2871tiqmHQMmiP48iXFM6OQUuBPxKDdnkkNzBoAx1nTOQpIE98eURLkSJ_rx6DRZ7QWwbFH8WgaG5PjNxScGT5hnH1xI-ZAneJp5k4eTe53hPHCV1g0GLkTSOv_26fX0y16-AsU7frCUdH-k9xy6Kx2-G8d6m8MC2mBZ3_ubH_6vo08B0AAP__Znx7Hg) before she shot and killed the singer-songwriter. The parole board, citing the brutality of Saldívar’s crimes and her “[conscious disregard](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFugzAQQL_GbEbnwwYzeOjClq4d0QVfEksXOwU3hL-v0r3zk96T3tdpPlGSlK-fdOdQX5cyI6DT0Gkc50hJjtk2MZwhjqbhYAbboe0NDM0t2ME7xt6iA2uAF7tchrh4tuCcc6NvUnjLoMPRgPPgW3s-m7FDQN87ZiBlgWOqZW3rjSu_aLvIUZ68tku5NxJutT421X0onBRO-763tUQ63lThlHnfFE4bC2fS3z8pV8pJhPRRhHIkvZHE9KRVP2gtwjpyThz1umQyo0ffNWuIjz2JpK0flIXrnZL8xeu_N54BfwMAAP__s4JiLg)” for others, denied her release; her next review is scheduled for March 2030. ## Woman Goes into Labor at Walmart

name: Sarah McAbee, Stand in the Gap
subject: Trump Pardons J6ers… Now what?
body:
First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

| | |
---
| | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/vu0IB2QHWH7moZWu8JFjAW8nCL5zUTpxWbPTdHBoHeSKBjRvR0pk_2aa4gYpkYG3nvdyojofdnt3Ec5-DwOB7v5mDlNLPXuyALzv5pPv49i7DuOxLRrL5yhGdYyKVBJxQk1ojiRYFv1t4nd5mYlCOQVcgdtFXLA1iaSToz0-Mgls0cPXaGZkdfBWw6ClsAtViuU06CwHrJlwVaMo6anByhklNtU1Phm05aqOWe5SEIySLOTtWQ8vM8OZW6Uu9emQEpOvWMmsUMfF_axqDxGpMxa2XPDeBFQWsqnGktTjXVP3Oy0GV5QTG5qlQQ2VnaYf4mQq7n04azWCbnzPRgWk8FYFsiQt/4fsRVmVbJxnXP4bb6-jXKcSEmFH0TLzh/7) Friend,

First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

Even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers...

**I work directly with many of the J6ers. And here are some of the issues they face: Some are homeless to this day. Some can’t get a job because of the time they’ve spent in jail. And many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life.**

They have had their rights stripped from them. Many have been separated from their families for years. They can’t vote. They can’t own a firearm.

Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions.

_And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights._

So, what comes next for J6ers?

There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. That’s exactly what Stand in the Gap is helping them do.

[Friend, as a personal favor to me, can you please send an urgent donation of $10 or more to support Stand in the Gap? I am hoping to get 100 new supporters to help us in our mission to rebuild the lives of J6ers who need us now more than ever.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/jYnp1Zj-6nrKcVYquc9peGSweyY0lQShNv5WRaQ2EVZDzx7e-Pf86Ht0aC2cFah4A_eG2ydMh4iSfsYG4ypYPNaA9eHYROu6lSeR5di2YaLU_ybMIpI7kfx1IzRLMHZMZKDZJLRzi-MgXvls_SENXFPkgA0xx9G0Q8jJ7grj83Pdkltc9DaqFcjqCtyKDFJAFwOCfY4DiTZovljqWoDeLYjqY-eaBSHMnn93QMJFKQ0cB4zbCDRtY3i0wmdDxhAqMOTwwcz5GzRgERHQlP97DGAcz178hxXCG4M6E4xls0OTSwTSgT3woQVVyhdEyHhQp98DNJTFgbdnn2ODeEbdKNKUlwVS/GVmy9Z0LJ1fQ3FbtpF_saD5D_kjCu69e/7)
[Donate](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/pQybTarFRwlC1oa34h8Zy0wGeqOcVctK7NHvCPSN3SakYohc65UJ9rPH7FNxXa6hZD_M4fml32mJ9CxZRixxAHLkUut045jaOGK4vviXR9fDspNhMtJ4nOQxPOJ9evpXDU0qUB0bV6t4k-Mg1s6yPuSfq5-qjCLf6HH-oDBS9N6NNv-rhphsaJhUTIn5PH-xoEPqxvoDd88nz_3ulyGqCYo9BrZ8SRhhKTf57mWOtix4OJml6Ypn-5pBqOSBBzIEzNeFkiYBemQo4nzTW565B_BjZG7sjyRWTTfeiXc8hdbRO9zlGmE8WEL5FxekBWENfJTgbpelCY5iF8oPa3-024d4TaVB/Z88mpib1YwD0qcLQr5klxFDsxQsf_rCQ/7)
Stand in the Gap originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is helping the recently released J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated.

One of the simplest ways we are helping them is by providing them with insurance and the resources to meet their healthcare needs.

Many of the J6ers haven’t seen a dentist or doctor in four years. They’ve lost their jobs, which means they’ve lost their insurance.

Our mission is to ensure that every J6er not only has access to healthcare to meet all of their medical needs but also receives the help they need to heal mentally, emotionally, and financially.

[Please consider donating $10, $35, $50, $100, or any amount you can generously afford today. >>](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/SYk3TLp5CRqlK6HqLqlJv0DyO4mpN-CU27r-1T5xoFF_891jfmMYP_SXOHxiFfcvPvf4y8mTt3vGNZleNgZy9eZKd6LyiTDwLde0jMHBqjCK_iNnwy4inPGmqmZIGRvMKS4amfXTDbqhSQmqrf9uUGOHT_L3bfX4khZjMtHb6gChnzb3O9gEOUsbcVEkU56_04Jj0P39Wi7Qc_kDLInwcWXWvf_CJLeFDanYtEuw4_Ubv8xZnp-_tLEiD0wFAtuLmp3K43xSLhs4SX5le-mAUN_FXJVXxoIirYjmNYN-suCqs2e6d9aBwH0v0bsoDSfhCNaWAuJv3a6HYyxDPNS5GDpPo2bi/w7Z6vm1QxyAGsJxCqJSLjhUHxfTqf8Zv/7)
[Donate](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/uEN5GL5xzIXTT7E-DkrjAKlzX482F7rPy5LOVQsGXdD65Fv--NVVn34-xpXMAv4qtyR7Gt1T9_JRtOpQlWK5p9YIFSMXbGc-AUpBqghskGit1aBKuMUc6Quga4aFCd4Dubslan5qMT60tVP76nWfCzJA0UqzmI6mKvNGg1J2E5DtJpeZF96uiKccB8uahGjYuGhXbJY-XtIaXWo9OJTSL9HwoNUKQDVsllK8PH5f5FgXJSUIQbxa6ysEzbmH9y8ysbQY8ynmueW96HQcJCYQ9lolgVapxX1cm01uGd041UvF_TBel0A5XZP2ch_yQmfDo0_ko2wbwb-kL10t1QNWhN00LgX2/2nphwUk8KJph1VORyJPgtAotwSXaiCHD/7)
Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not.

We were founded to “stand in the gap” for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. Our primary aim is to let them know that they are not forgotten. This begins by providing health insurance to meet immediate physical needs and evolves as Stand In The Gap is the one-stop shop for any J6er in need of counseling as they reintegrate back into society.

The J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers, and It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity.

[If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me today by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand In The Gap provide healthcare and counseling to our J6 community.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/-iKCtMusnfFEEK3z2wl3RSv3lkiY0UQCIlJ2Fbqsr9uc5md4new3prrzuqrcCNDJkw1psM8ACaU9GBs1jwATxvYHBkVXThdltO5r_RXwjjaKRwqa7peSMdtTeuxTH6EcrpZMIvm15msY2Q-t2MbsG9CpCMUhPRexs8eeVqDK0usALv9FzHZ_2laxlkS1HBSzianRLxttCHP8LaK-KuNCJa9596bbwtGxIKlChfEb6r5yAujrDvg4n2cT5xxGT9wujmRFFB7_iUBDUOy3qFInfxVyzth-gFnsB9Gps9aEXtTueroXXyiYdOXqd6m7zrl-oHV4SqxSCETn4qoAp9lW8kvxmmOh/evJsk0i0EnynyM6yvB97uPDwL5rIXMmJ/7)

Sincerely,

Sarah McAbee
Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer, Stand in the Gap

body:

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ae9w/?__vbtrk=MjgyMDc0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgyMDc0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

Fellow Patriot,
When I announced my bid for Governor a month ago it was like I threw a match inside a _radical-left powder keg_.
Now, the Democrats are more united than ever against _ME_ \- and chaos is erupting across the country!
This is Byron Donalds, President Trump’s endorsed candidate for Florida Governor, and I need to let you in on what’s happening.
Since Trump’s _**[landslide victory](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ae9w/?__vbtrk=MjgyMDc0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgyMDc0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**_ , Democrats have been running around like chickens with their heads cut off:
They’ve been throwing punches in a hundred different directions with nothing landing. Then Trump endorsed my race and _everything_ changed.

|
---
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ae9w/?__vbtrk=MjgyMDc0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgyMDc0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
|
---
**The Democrat’s response has been nothing short of a ruthless onslaught:**
> They’re calling up their radical allies in the Fake News to spin lies about me & my family.

body:
After Mexico won its independence from Spain in 1821, its political environment was unstable, and its relationship with France — another European colonial power — was tense.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68eovht7uc1ahw5owlpqqbyc42ccmcwdghn3he9rm1jr72gx0ww0wgnzd17qi89uog5fsuagv8elbli0b64iur7nof65s2ch61ogdmai8xyj44pf711upybm23r3ly7jmgkv0xc4xn1jvf65d&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [France and Mexico fought a war over pastries. ](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [World History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| A fter Mexico won its independence from Spain in 1821, its political environment was unstable, and its relationship with France — another European colonial power — was tense. These tensions came to a head in 1832, when a group of Mexican army officers went into a pastry shop outside Mexico City. The shop was owned by one [Monsieur Remontel](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), a French national. The officers helped themselves to every pastry in his shop — after confining the owner to a room, according to some sources — and then left without paying. Afterward, Remontel demanded an enormous sum of 60,000 pesos as compensation from the Mexican government — about 60 times the total value of his shop.
---
Remontel wasn’t the only Frenchman to lodge such a complaint. Foreign nationals living in Mexico at the time, including a large population of French residents, started to complain about property damage sustained during civil disturbances, and sought redress from the Mexican government, with no success. Remontel became a kind of poster child for the growing demands, and in 1837, the French government got involved. France drew a hard line, [demanding](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) that Mexico pay a total of 600,000 pesos or prepare for war. The Mexican government couldn’t pay, so the French navy instituted a blockade at Veracruz, the main Mexican port along the Gulf of Mexico. After seven months, French soldiers escalated by firing on the fortress of San Juan de Ulúa and occupying the city. France eventually withdrew after being guaranteed payment through Great Britain.
Officially, the conflict was called the first Franco-Mexican War, but it became known derisively as the Pastry War in Mexico. Though the conflict may sound petty, it had a major influence on Mexican history. During the war, troops were led by Antonio López de Santa Anna, the former president of Mexico who was disgraced after losing Texas to the United States. Santa Anna lost a leg fighting the French (it was amputated after being injured by cannon fire), and the incident restored his public reputation. He went on to become president of Mexico seven more times.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## The Mexican president staged an elaborate funeral for his leg.
Antonio López de Santa Anna was known for his flamboyant personality. After losing his leg in the Pastry War, he had it [buried at his hacienda](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stvtla&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) in Veracruz. In 1842, while he was serving as president of Mexico, he dug up the limb and had an ornate coach parade it to Mexico City, where he gave it a full state funeral with cannon fire, poetry, and speeches. But public opinion turned against Santa Anna again, and just two years later, when three-time Mexican President José Joaquín Antonio de Herrera led a successful revolt against Santa Anna, protesters dug the leg back up and dragged it through the streets.

clean_body: After Mexico won its independence from Spain in 1821, its political environment was unstable, and its relationship with France — another European colonial power — was tense. | A fter Mexico won its independence from Spain in 1821, its political environment was unstable, and its relationship with France — another European colonial power — was tense. These tensions came to a head in 1832, when a group of Mexican army officers went into a pastry shop outside Mexico City. The shop was owned by one , a French national. The officers helped themselves to every pastry in his shop — after confining the owner to a room, according to some sources — and then left without paying. Afterward, Remontel demanded an enormous sum of 60,000 pesos as compensation from the Mexican government — about 60 times the total value of his shop. Remontel wasn’t the only Frenchman to lodge such a complaint. Foreign nationals living in Mexico at the time, including a large population of French residents, started to complain about property damage sustained during civil disturbances, and sought redress from the Mexican government, with no success. Remontel became a kind of poster child for the growing demands, and in 1837, the French government got involved. France drew a hard line, that Mexico pay a total of 600,000 pesos or prepare for war. The Mexican government couldn’t pay, so the French navy instituted a blockade at Veracruz, the main Mexican port along the Gulf of Mexico. After seven months, French soldiers escalated by firing on the fortress of San Juan de Ulúa and occupying the city. France eventually withdrew after being guaranteed payment through Great Britain. Officially, the conflict was called the first Franco-Mexican War, but it became known derisively as the Pastry War in Mexico. Though the conflict may sound petty, it had a major influence on Mexican history. During the war, troops were led by Antonio López de Santa Anna, the former president of Mexico who was disgraced after losing Texas to the United States. Santa Anna lost a leg fighting the French (it was amputated after being injured by cannon fire), and the incident restored his public reputation. He went on to become president of Mexico seven more times. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . Antonio López de Santa Anna was known for his flamboyant personality. After losing his leg in the Pastry War, he had it in Veracruz. In 1842, while he was serving as president of Mexico, he dug up the limb and had an ornate coach parade it to Mexico City, where he gave it a full state funeral with cannon fire, poetry, and speeches. But public opinion turned against Santa Anna again, and just two years later, when three-time Mexican President José Joaquín Antonio de Herrera led a successful revolt against Santa Anna, protesters dug the leg back up and dragged it through the streets. name: Matt Cartwright
subject: Big News on the NEPA Rail Project
body:
We're now one of only 5 projects in the nation.

| | | | |
---
| Aerial shot of our Delaware River railroad bridge, last year
---
| | | | | Checking In with Matt Cartwright
---
| | | | | It’s officially spring now, but over the years March has fooled us so many times, I’m not putting away the snow shovel just yet.
Marion and I have been keeping busy — she’s getting ready for an important trial, and I’ve been working hard at teaching a senior seminar on Congress up at Hamilton College, in upstate New York. I’ve also been doing the 36 hours of Continuing Legal Education credits I need to dust off my Pennsylvania law license, after 12 years of Inactive status.
And I was so honored to be appointed this year to the Pennsylvania Northeast Regional Rail Authority Board, which owns the freight rails in our area, and is working on reestablishing passenger rail service with New York City. We had that train service for over 100 years, and we need it back. Amtrak economists estimate that the new line will generate $84 million _every year_ in additional economic activity for our area. That means more jobs, good jobs, and better paying jobs. We need them, and that’s why I worked with PNRRA for 12 years pushing that project. The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law paved the way for us to get that new line, and at my request, Governor Josh Shapiro gave it his full backing.
The big news is that our project has now been accepted into Phase 2 of the Federal Railroad Administration’s Corridor ID program. **We’re one of only 5 new rail lines in the country** that have made it so far. I joined the PNRRA board to keep that momentum going. I had my first board meeting with them this week, and things are looking good. I’ll keep you posted on that.
Be safe and well, and [Stay in Touch](mailto:matt699dw@gmail.com?subject=&body=)!

subject: Income tax elimination is a BIG win for freedom!
body:

---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **What a win!** This week, Mississippi made history as the first state in the U.S.—aside from oil-rich Alaska—to pass legislation eliminating the income tax.

While nine other states have never had an income tax, Mississippi is blazing a trail by actively dismantling it.

**“So what?”, you might say. “Why does this matter if full elimination is still a decade away?”** The answer is simple: it’s already transforming our state for the better.

**Eliminating the income tax makes Mississippi a magnet for growth.** Look at Texas, Florida, and Tennessee—three southern states without income taxes that are booming. Even Arkansas recently lowered its rate to stay competitive with us!

Since we began reducing our rate to a flat 4% in 2022, the Mississippi Development Agency reports an extraordinary $25 billion in inward investment. Businesses are flocking here, confident that the payroll tax burden is fading away.

**This victory isn’t just about economics—it’s a triumph for conservative reform.**

Around the Governor’s desk on Thursday evening, we saw bold leadership from Speaker Jason White, Rep. Trey Lamar, and a few dedicated others who fought for this change. We should not forget the role of former Speaker, Philip Gunn, either.

Mississippi is, as you know, full of southern charm. One consequence of this is that each time a significant reform passes in the state legislature, there is a tendency to pretend that the change came about because of some kind of kumbaya consensus.

This success proves that the roadblocks to reform can be overcome with bold, principled leadership.

---

For the last five years my wife, Marilyn, has worked across the globe to reduce the level of mercury contamination in the developing world. This week, the same administration that claims vaccines damage children announced that coal plants could start dumping mercury-- a toxin proven to create birth defects and brain damage in children-- right here in America again.
Welcome to the new America, folks. Today, Marilyn tells us what this change means for all of us. Please share it far and wide with anyone you think might be interested, and thank you for the ongoing support!
Lucas's Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9sdWNhc2t1bmNlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.jg2tEFKtL1P45uR9Iy9CEm9kIHEtaijhY_km5aDiW04?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=160109754)
* * *
This week, I was devastated to learn that as part of rolling back dozens of environmental rules, the Trump administration is going to let coal-fired power plants and other industrial polluters return to [dumping](https://substack.com/redirect/f9bb2091-295d-4456-8a70-cb4bd1124a64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) toxins like mercury, arsenic, and benzene into American air and water. Claiming that this pollution is necessary to address a "national emergency," the administration has even set up what critics are calling a "[polluters' portal](https://substack.com/redirect/e1e0ebef-f828-4b89-81f6-8a9daf67fb2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" - an electronic mailbox where companies can quickly and easily request the President's sign-off to quickly get back to dumping mercury in our air and water. It's now easier to poison our country with mercury than it is for a senior to get the social security they earned.
As someone who has spent years fighting mercury pollution, this news hits too close to home.
If you're not very familiar with what mercury is or, for the matter, how dangerous it is, you're not the only one. The first memory I have of mercury being introduced to me was as a kid. My dad used to have a little jar with a small ball of this sort of liquid-ish metal that we children were forbidden to grab unless dad brought it up and supervised us. It was fun to squeeze it and see it break into even smaller balls and then put it all together again. Why did we have this at home? I honestly couldn't tell you, but that's the only memory I have of mercury until later in middle school in chemistry class. We were taught that metallic or elemental mercury -- an odorless, shiny, silver-white liquid -- is commonly used in thermometers, barometers and fluorescent light bulbs. We were told that metallic mercury is extremely dangerous with a few drops generating enough fumes to contaminate the air in a room and that skin contact with the metal results in the absorption of mercury into the blood stream and potential health problems.
Never again did I hear about mercury usage until I was an adult and had the opportunity to work for the Natural Resources Defense Council under the [planetGOLD programme](https://substack.com/redirect/2c4aad9a-e1cf-44b7-a254-7f07d12e7e1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). We work across the globe to eliminate the use of mercury by artisanal and small-scale miners, which has been the largest source of mercury pollution in the world since more advanced countries took measures to reduce mercury contamination.
The reason mercury is used in gold mining is because it has a special characteristic that makes it combine with gold into an amalgam, or combined metal, which helps miners collect fine gold particles from sediment. All around the world these subsistence miners take dirt or sand out of pits and rivers, pour mercury into it, swish it around, and look for clumps of amalgamated gold.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/01a8a018-ca80-44fc-96fb-9f318384770c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
They then take those clumps and burn off the mercury, which leaves behind gold. It's incredibly toxic and not only extremely dangerous for the miners and their communities, but for all of us.
In the last 5 years I've learned about mercury, and it's hard to overstate how dangerous mercury is for public health. Just to name a few examples, mercury exposure can cause irreversible brain damage, especially in children, and fetuses can suffer life-long harm from exposure in the womb. [There is ](https://substack.com/redirect/af0589b1-4034-4a75-83c2-621691b99527?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[no](https://substack.com/redirect/af0589b1-4034-4a75-83c2-621691b99527?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ known safe level of mercury for humans](https://substack.com/redirect/af0589b1-4034-4a75-83c2-621691b99527?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and even low doses can be hazardous. In fact, the World Health Organization ranks mercury among the top ten chemicals of major public health concern globally. And unlike many pollutants, mercury doesn't stay put in one place - once released (for example, from a power plant smokestack), it can vaporize and travel far afield, contaminating ecosystems and communities thousands of miles away. This is quite common! As many of the artisanal small-scale operations I mentioned before happen alongside rivers and in areas with wildfires, the mercury they don't burn off for gold goes into the soil and then when wildfires happen, it still gets released into the atmosphere. Mercury pollution is _everyone 's_ problem, not just a local issue.

Having visited some of these mining communities, I saw miners often handle mercury with bare hands to extract gold, unaware of the poison they and their families are absorbing. There are an estimated 10-20 million people in over 70 countries working as small scale miners - including up to 5 million women and children. Many of these miners show signs of mercury poisoning, and I can tell you, it shows.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/30e5171f-77f3-4c3b-8bfb-cc685f70e44e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_My last site visit, in Kenya_
All of this makes the EPA's recent retreat on mercury limits feel like a gut punch. We are bringing this pain back to our country. It's not just a U.S. regulatory tweak - it's a massive step backward for America. For my fellow pregnant mothers (I'm at 8 months!) who don't eat fish because of the mercury, but will now be forced to breath it in.
It's about the American children who will now be born with birth defects that they otherwise wouldn't have had. It's about what this says about our priorities, that our leaders are willing to actively encourage industrialists to convert children's health and suffering into profit for their shareholders.
The worst part is that mercury doesn't just disappear once it's released. Once in the wild it frequently becomes methylmercury - a far more dangerous form of the chemical that accumulates in the food chain. Fish in particular can become heavily contaminated. That mercury then enters the bodies of people who consume it, contributing to all the health problems I mentioned before.

Every step forward we have taken to reduce mercury emissions has been hard-earned. For example, in my experience in the artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM) sector, we've worked tirelessly to educate miners, improve their techniques, and introduce alternatives that reduce mercury use. And we've seen real results helping transition these subsistence miners to alternatives.
It's remarkable to me that so many of them have successfully changed their method of mining to reduce mercury pollution--with no expertise, no understanding of the problem, no resources, no alternative income, and living in the most extreme poverty on the planet, yet our fat cat industrialists and shareholders, in supposedly the most innovative and certainly the most resourced country on the planet, are running to daddy begging for a handout because they just can't figure out how to make money without killing children.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2bea33b9-d675-4a79-bc5f-dce2ea71ff65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_The mining community I worked with in Kenya_
To twist the phrase, this move to expose Americans to mercury again really feels like one step forward, and two steps back.
I'm proud to be part of the crowd, with you, taking the step forward, and hope you'll continue to support Lucas and me in our work to overcome those who keep pushing us back.
-Marilyn

While claiming that vaccines hurt kids | | | Mar 29 | | | | | | | | | | | | For the last five years my wife, Marilyn, has worked across the globe to reduce the level of mercury contamination in the developing world. This week, the same administration that claims vaccines damage children announced that coal plants could start dumping mercury-- a toxin proven to create birth defects and brain damage in children-- right here in America again. Welcome to the new America, folks. Today, Marilyn tells us what this change means for all of us. Please share it far and wide with anyone you think might be interested, and thank you for the ongoing support! Lucas's Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. * This week, I was devastated to learn that as part of rolling back dozens of environmental rules, the Trump administration is going to let coal-fired power plants and other industrial polluters return to toxins like mercury, arsenic, and benzene into American air and water. Claiming that this pollution is necessary to address a "national emergency," the administration has even set up what critics are calling a "" - an electronic mailbox where companies can quickly and easily request the President's sign-off to quickly get back to dumping mercury in our air and water. It's now easier to poison our country with mercury than it is for a senior to get the social security they earned. As someone who has spent years fighting mercury pollution, this news hits too close to home. If you're not very familiar with what mercury is or, for the matter, how dangerous it is, you're not the only one. The first memory I have of mercury being introduced to me was as a kid. My dad used to have a little jar with a small ball of this sort of liquid-ish metal that we children were forbidden to grab unless dad brought it up and supervised us. It was fun to squeeze it and see it break into even smaller balls and then put it all together again. Why did we have this at home? I honestly couldn't tell you, but that's the only memory I have of mercury until later in middle school in chemistry class. We were taught that metallic or elemental mercury -- an odorless, shiny, silver-white liquid -- is commonly used in thermometers, barometers and fluorescent light bulbs. We were told that metallic mercury is extremely dangerous with a few drops generating enough fumes to contaminate the air in a room and that skin contact with the metal results in the absorption of mercury into the blood stream and potential health problems. Never again did I hear about mercury usage until I was an adult and had the opportunity to work for the Natural Resources Defense Council under the . We work across the globe to eliminate the use of mercury by artisanal and small-scale miners, which has been the largest source of mercury pollution in the world since more advanced countries took measures to reduce mercury contamination. The reason mercury is used in gold mining is because it has a special characteristic that makes it combine with gold into an amalgam, or combined metal, which helps miners collect fine gold particles from sediment. All around the world these subsistence miners take dirt or sand out of pits and rivers, pour mercury into it, swish it around, and look for clumps of amalgamated gold. | | ---|---|--- They then take those clumps and burn off the mercury, which leaves behind gold. It's incredibly toxic and not only extremely dangerous for the miners and their communities, but for all of us. In the last 5 years I've learned about mercury, and it's hard to overstate how dangerous mercury is for public health. Just to name a few examples, mercury exposure can cause irreversible brain damage, especially in children, and fetuses can suffer life-long harm from exposure in the womb. , and even low doses can be hazardous. In fact, the World Health Organization ranks mercury among the top ten chemicals of major public health concern globally. And unlike many pollutants, mercury doesn't stay put in one place - once released (for example, from a power plant smokestack), it can vaporize and travel far afield, contaminating ecosystems and communities thousands of miles away. This is quite common! As many of the artisanal small-scale operations I mentioned before happen alongside rivers and in areas with wildfires, the mercury they don't burn off for gold goes into the soil and then when wildfires happen, it still gets released into the atmosphere. Mercury pollution is everyone 's problem, not just a local issue. Having visited some of these mining communities, I saw miners often handle mercury with bare hands to extract gold, unaware of the poison they and their families are absorbing. There are an estimated 10-20 million people in over 70 countries working as small scale miners - including up to 5 million women and children. Many of these miners show signs of mercury poisoning, and I can tell you, it shows. | | ---|---|--- My last site visit, in Kenya All of this makes the EPA's recent retreat on mercury limits feel like a gut punch. We are bringing this pain back to our country. It's not just a U.S. regulatory tweak - it's a massive step backward for America. For my fellow pregnant mothers (I'm at 8 months!) who don't eat fish because of the mercury, but will now be forced to breath it in. It's about the American children who will now be born with birth defects that they otherwise wouldn't have had. It's about what this says about our priorities, that our leaders are willing to actively encourage industrialists to convert children's health and suffering into profit for their shareholders. The worst part is that mercury doesn't just disappear once it's released. Once in the wild it frequently becomes methylmercury - a far more dangerous form of the chemical that accumulates in the food chain. Fish in particular can become heavily contaminated. That mercury then enters the bodies of people who consume it, contributing to all the health problems I mentioned before. Every step forward we have taken to reduce mercury emissions has been hard-earned. For example, in my experience in the artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM) sector, we've worked tirelessly to educate miners, improve their techniques, and introduce alternatives that reduce mercury use. And we've seen real results helping transition these subsistence miners to alternatives. It's remarkable to me that so many of them have successfully changed their method of mining to reduce mercury pollution--with no expertise, no understanding of the problem, no resources, no alternative income, and living in the most extreme poverty on the planet, yet our fat cat industrialists and shareholders, in supposedly the most innovative and certainly the most resourced country on the planet, are running to daddy begging for a handout because they just can't figure out how to make money without killing children. | | ---|---|--- The mining community I worked with in Kenya To twist the phrase, this move to expose Americans to mercury again really feels like one step forward, and two steps back. I'm proud to be part of the crowd, with you, taking the step forward, and hope you'll continue to support Lucas and me in our work to overcome those who keep pushing us back. -Marilyn Lucas's Substack is a reader-supported publication. Did you know that 50,000 of your brain cells die every day?

**If you’re over 50 and you forget a name, misplace your keys, or just feel foggy all the time — that means your brain cells are dying off even faster.**

I was shocked to learn this myself.

It turns out... _Stanford University_ neuroscientists identified a nasty “cell invader.” It attacks cells in the memory center of your brain - the hippocampus - causing your brain to shrink.

Thankfully there’s something you can do from home to clear it out.

A reporter asked President Donald Trump **["What is a woman?"](https://substack.com/redirect/ae0af98b-2f3d-4129-9f0f-8db06b530e64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during a Friday press conference. His answer is absolutely worth a watch:

"I wanted to say happy Women's Month," the reporter started his question to the President. "Thank you so much for keeping men out of women's sports. You have platformed so many great women like your Chief of Staff Susie Wile, your Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt, and now Alina who will be joining as well."
"Since Democrats seem to struggle answering this question, I wanted to ask you what is a woman?" the reporter continued.
"Well it's sort of easy for me to answer,..." Trump began to respond.

According to _Politico_ , Hegseth addressed the issue briefly Wednesday during a weeklong Asia trip. The information in the messages "doesn’t look like war plans," he said. "You know who sees war plans? I see them. Every single day.”

To be clear: if the messages were leaked, it could have put American military personnel in danger.

This is just another example of how toxic masculinity is running rampant in our government. It also serves as a cause for serious concern about the temperament and ability of America’s leaders tasked with negotiating peace on the global stage, as national security remains a pressing topic. **At Her Bold Move, we know that the world would be a better place with a more feminine approach to these issues.**

**According to international data collected from 1989 to 2011,_when women are involved in peace agreements, peace is 35% more likely to last 15+ years._ On the flipside, war disproportionately impacts women – often in radical and unimaginably dangerous ways.**

At Her Bold Move, we understand our responsibility in this moment. | | I wasn’t expecting to hear Donald Trump attack me in front of a joint session of Congress earlier this month, but I can’t say I was surprised. He’s obsessed with using the power of his platform to smear and attempt to silence those who challenge him. And he’s desperate to deflect attention from his broken promises. So he went after me, not because I did something wrong, but because I did something right. It’s because I’ve fought alongside you and the Fair Fight team to protect the freedom to vote, a fundamental American value he tries to rip away. And it’s because — through the work he singled out — I’ve helped bring down costs for families, a promise he’s failed to keep. To get away with his actual, unpopular agenda — taking money from working people to fund tax breaks for the ultra-rich — this petty tyrant and his complicit flunkies hope that Americans can be played for suckers, or lose focus. And, chillingly, the authoritarian far right hopes they can undermine the ultimate failsafe in our democracy: the ability of the people to change the direction of our government at the ballot box. But we will not be duped. We will not be distracted. And we will not be silenced. **With our democracy facing the gravest threats we’ve seen in our lifetimes, it’s never been more critical to support groups like Fair Fight that defend free and fair elections.** [**That’s why I need to ask if you can make a donation of any amount to Fair Fight. As they map out their plans to combat voter suppression in this new Trump era, they’ve set a target of 150 new donations before Monday’s end-of-quarter deadline. I want to help them reach that goal, so I’m sending you this message, and I’m making this request.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104734397/536318950/-594900150?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250329_f_SYAEOQ_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzIxOWRmMC1hMTBjLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FmIza29bFLq8u1vkX1azSVeJ2I4zzvXTrcMURHw0Gco=) | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104734404/536318965/-594900150?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250329_f_SYAEOQ_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzIxOWRmMC1hMTBjLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FmIza29bFLq8u1vkX1azSVeJ2I4zzvXTrcMURHw0Gco=)
---
After the 2018 elections, I started Fair Fight to help make sure every eligible voter can easily register to vote, cast their ballot, and have it counted.
And I knew that if anti-voter radicals and blatant authoritarians gained greater power in America, we’d need strong hubs of organizing to push back. We knew that days like these could come.
Since its founding, Fair Fight has successfully combated voter suppression, made it possible for more people to exercise their power and their voice at the ballot box, and helped elect pro-democracy champions from municipal governments to the U.S. Senate.
In 2025 and beyond, Fair Fight will continue building pro-voter political power in the South, expanding access to voting, fighting back against mass voter purges, and pioneering strategic analysis and innovation to counter rising authoritarianism.

body:
Is it active shooter drills, mass shootings, or is it personal?
#

Friends -
Why is the issue of gun safety important to you?
Has this issue touched you personally like it has Gabby and her family? Are you just sick of seeing the mass shootings at schools play out on television and tired of politicians who refuse to act? Are you a parent or grandparent who tears up when they hear their kids explain going through active shooter drills, too young to even fathom what that means?
Whatever it is, gun violence prevention is an issue that unites almost all Americans. It's why this issue, above almost any other, enjoys support from Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike.
It's also an issue at great risk in the weeks and months ahead. It's at risk because of Donald Trump, Kash Patel, Elon Musk, and more.
And that's why Gabby needs your help.
Our first quarterly fundraising deadline since Trump took office is just days away and our fundraising has fallen faster than Elon Musk's approval ratings. So we're really hoping for lots and lots of individual donations to catch up.
This is an issue that means so much to so many. But our gun safety laws are in grave danger. So please:

Derek — We don’t have to wait until the midterms to elect more Democrats who will check Trump’s power in their states, cities, and districts. On Tuesday, we have a chance to do just that. Here’s what’s happening in two key states:
**In Florida,** there are _two_ special elections for congressional seats. If we win both races, Democrats will flip two seats and weaken Republicans’ razor-thin House majority. Winning in Florida is not going to be easy, but since Trump’s election, we’ve seen Democrats overperform in special elections nationwide. If we can reach, persuade, and mobilize a huge number of undecided voters in the final days of this race, it could make all the difference. **In Wisconsin,** control of the state’s Supreme Court is on the line. Elon Musk is spending millions of dollars boosting Republican Brad Schimel — all with the goal of creating a MAGA Supreme Court that will rubber-stamp the Trump-Musk agenda. The only way we’re going to stop the richest person in the world from trying to buy this election is if we all get involved.

It’s been five days since reporting showed that our country’s National Security Advisor and Secretary of Defense demonstrated a profound and egregious carelessness with America’s national security and the lives of our servicemembers.
Why has there been no disciplinary action for those involved in this massive irresponsibility?
Donald Trump made a literal show out of firing people for way smaller mistakes, from way less important jobs.
It’s hard to imagine a bigger mistake Pete Hegseth and Michael Waltz could have made to put servicemembers’ lives at risk.
But suddenly Trump is too scared to fire people? Give me a break.
Our President and the rest of our national security leadership should be the people most concerned about this situation, not shrugging it off — or worse, flat-out lying to the American people about it.
I’m demanding answers — and action — from this Administration. But you have a role to play in this, too. If you agree that Pete Hegseth and Michael Waltz ought to resign, help put the pressure on with a public outcry.
Add your name today to demand disciplinary action against the so-called leaders who so cavalierly put our national security at risk. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/D7ag4Xb8kEaUJ2crQ346gg2]
Thanks for speaking up. I won’t stop pushing to make this right.
-Tim Kaine

subject: Pete Hegseth must resign.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
The Signal incident is what happens when you have the most unqualified Secretary of Defense we've ever seen.
#

Hey everybody, it’s Mark. Take a look at this picture:
[](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/hegseth_em_signup_march25_AB/?source=em250329-1-500&akid=6027%2E6688874%2EdR-kw8)
That’s me, about 30 years ago. I flew 39 missions in Desert Storm. In one of them, I was nearly shot down by two different surface-to-air missiles. I don’t even want to consider what might’ve happened if the Iraqis had two hours notice before I took off from the USS Midway that day.
I’m telling you this because the Atlantic published the rest of the group chat. And those messages confirmed Hegseth did — without any doubt — send timetables and mission details that would be highly classified. He sent them two hours in advance. If the details of that chat were published or if an adversary had access to them, it would have put pilots at risk.
The Signal incident is what happens when you have the most unqualified Secretary of Defense we've ever seen.
We're lucky it didn't cost any servicemembers their lives, but for the safety of our military and our country, Secretary Hegseth needs to resign.
[**I need you with me on this. Sign on now and join me in demanding that Secretary Hegseth tender his resignation before he puts the lives of our troops at risk again.**](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/hegseth_em_signup_march25_AB/?source=em250329-1-500&akid=6027%2E6688874%2EdR-kw8)

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: It’s been a wild ride.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.
#

Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben.
You might be wondering how this kid...
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=1&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
...ended up where I am now.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=2&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
Let me take you back to the beginning. It all started in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=3&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=4&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=5&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
I deployed to al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest hit Marine unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=6&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=7&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=8&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
So, I decided to run for U.S. Senate. I took on one of Trump’s most devoted supporters. It was one of the hardest fought and most competitive elections in the country, but I defeated her.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=9&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.
But in the years since, I’ve learned a thing or two. I know that it’s the people like my mom, my old boss who let me fill out college applications on the job, the librarian that believed in me, and the marines I fought beside who are going to suffer because of what Trump and Elon are doing.
I also learned a thing or two about beating these clowns. And for the next four years, I’m going to be a thorn in their side. I am not going to stop working to defend what makes this country great — and to build on it so that my kids can live the American Dream.
[**If you are still with me, please. It’d mean a lot if you could chip in before our first FEC deadline of the year. I can’t do this work alone — never could.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250329-1-exp&t=10&akid=3782%2E734936%2EdDA6qu)

UNDERSTANDING ABORTION:

Education, Healing, and the Power of Story

4-week series

Mondays: April 7, 14, 21, 28

3pmPT/ 4pmMT/ 5pmCT/ 6pmET

Have you ever wondered about the stories you don’t hear when it comes to abortion?

In a world where abortion is often portrayed as a quick and simple decision, far too many women—and men—are left carrying silent
pain, trauma, and regret.

But what if the full story was brought into the light?
What if healing and hope were not only possible—but closer than you think?

We invite you to join Moms for America and Operation Outcry (a ministry of The Justice Foundation) for a special free 4-week
webinar series revealing the hidden impact of abortion through real testimonies, expert insights, and proven pathways to healing.

Each week, we’ll open the door to compassionate, honest conversations around:

🛑 The Reality of Abortion – The stories no one talks about, including men’s experiences and the documented trauma revealed by
research.

💊 The Rise of Chemical Abortion – What it is, how it works, and why it’s leaving women more vulnerable than ever.

💔 Healing and Recovery – Hopeful, practical steps that have helped women and men find true restoration.

🌱 Life After Abortion – How those affected are rebuilding, finding purpose, and making a difference.

Whether you're seeking answers, personal healing, or ways to better support others, this free series is designed to offer truth,
compassion, and empowerment—because no one should have to walk this journey alone.

🔥 Space is limited! Reserve your spot now and join us for this vital conversation. 🔥

Tuesdays at 11amPT/ 12pmMT/ 1pmCT/ 2pmET

What does freedom mean to you—and how can we ensure it thrives for future generations?

Just in time for the launch of our BRAND-NEW High School Credit-Earning Curriculum, Moms for America is thrilled to present
Cottage Meetings for Teens, hosted by Cassiopeia Fletcher, Executive Director of Membership & Education.

Building on Kimberly Fletcher’s foundational Cottage Meetings program, this interdisciplinary course weaves together American
history, classic literature, and the power of personal story to help teens explore the timeless themes of freedom and liberty.
Together, they’ll uncover the principles of representative government, individual rights, and religious freedom—core values
enshrined in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution.

But freedom isn’t just a lofty ideal—it begins at home. By nurturing strong values and leadership within the family, we empower
teens to create freer communities, stronger states, and ultimately a thriving nation. This course is a powerful step toward
raising the next generation of leaders who understand, value, and protect the legacy of liberty.

Will your family take the first step in safeguarding freedom for the future?

Don’t miss this opportunity—sign up today to join the journey!

take action to safeguard the future of our nation. Join Al & Juleen Jackson for Healing of America, a transformative 16-week
webinar series that explores the foundation of our republic, the structure of the Constitution, and the forces threatening our
freedoms. Discover practical strategies to overcome these challenges and heal America from the grassroots to the highest levels.

Through this series, you’ll gain a deeper understanding of the Constitution’s original intent, the ideals that make America
exceptional, and the steps needed to restore unity and strength across the nation. Whether you’re a seasoned patriot or new to
civic engagement, this is your opportunity to join a nationwide movement to preserve liberty for generations to come.

Don’t wait—reserve your spot today and be part of the solution. Together, we can protect and preserve our freedoms and rebuild
America’s greatness from the ground up.

Monday, April 14, 2025

Want to know how homeschooling through high school can set your student up for college success—and beyond?

Join us for this inspiring and practical webinar featuring Nadine Lauffer!

Nadine Lauffer, a 19-year-old homeschool graduate and physics freshman at Grove City College, is here to share her journey. In
2022, she launched the Fearlessly Different podcast to empower teens and families to embrace homeschooling through high school and
thrive. A sought-after speaker, Nadine recently presented at the 2024 Great Homeschool Convention in Cincinnati and was featured
in The Epoch Times. When she’s not podcasting, you’ll find her running, horseback riding, or playing the piano.

In this webinar, you’ll discover how to:

* Tackle common homeschooling challenges, from academics to social life and college prep.

* Equip your family with tools and strategies for a successful homeschool experience.

* Empower your student to take ownership of their education and transition confidently to college.

Whether you’re just beginning or deep into the high school years, this session will provide actionable insights and encouragement
from someone who’s been there—and thrived!

Think, Discuss, Grow: PragerU Empowers Moms to teach their TEENS about American Patriotism

APRIL 29, 2025

1pmPT/ 2pmMT/ 3pmCT/ 4pmET

Looking for a powerful way to engage your teens in real conversations about freedom, responsibility, and what it means to be an
American? Join us for the third installment of our inspiring webinar series with Jill Simonian of PragerU Kids as she circles back
to the Cottage Meetings for Teens curriculum, this time covering Lessons 7-12—a bold, conversation-driven program designed to help
young adults think critically and grow in confidence.

You’ll learn how to easily integrate PragerU’s high-quality videos and materials into your teen’s weekly rhythm, making topics
like civics, history, and values not only approachable—but actually enjoyable.

PragerU Kids equips families with free, engaging resources that celebrate American ideals—from Kindergarten all the way through
high school.

Jill Simonian, a passionate advocate for education and regular guest on Newsmax, Fox News, and OAN, brings her signature energy to
this session—helping moms lead the next generation with clarity and conviction.

Let’s raise teens who think deeply, speak boldly, and lead wisely. We can’t wait to see you there!

[] [] Don't miss ANY of our inspirational and equipping webinars or in-person events! [] [] UNDERSTANDING ABORTION: Education, Healing, and the Power of Story 4-week series Mondays: April 7, 14, 21, 28 3pmPT/ 4pmMT/ 5pmCT/ 6pmET Have you ever wondered about the stories you don’t hear when it comes to abortion? In a world where abortion is often portrayed as a quick and simple decision, far too many women—and men—are left carrying silent pain, trauma, and regret. But what if the full story was brought into the light? What if healing and hope were not only possible—but closer than you think? We invite you to join Moms for America and Operation Outcry (a ministry of The Justice Foundation) for a special free 4-week webinar series revealing the hidden impact of abortion through real testimonies, expert insights, and proven pathways to healing. Each week, we’ll open the door to compassionate, honest conversations around: 🛑 The Reality of Abortion – The stories no one talks about, including men’s experiences and the documented trauma revealed by research. 💊 The Rise of Chemical Abortion – What it is, how it works, and why it’s leaving women more vulnerable than ever. 💔 Healing and Recovery – Hopeful, practical steps that have helped women and men find true restoration. 🌱 Life After Abortion – How those affected are rebuilding, finding purpose, and making a difference. Whether you're seeking answers, personal healing, or ways to better support others, this free series is designed to offer truth, compassion, and empowerment—because no one should have to walk this journey alone. 🔥 Space is limited! Reserve your spot now and join us for this vital conversation. 🔥 Register - UNDERSTANDING ABORTION [] [] [-] FROM REVOLUTION TO REPUBLIC COTTAGE MEETINGS FOR TEENS Final 3 sessions: April 8, 15, and 22 - it's not too late to register! Tuesdays at 11amPT/ 12pmMT/ 1pmCT/ 2pmET What does freedom mean to you—and how can we ensure it thrives for future generations? Just in time for the launch of our BRAND-NEW High School Credit-Earning Curriculum, Moms for America is thrilled to present Cottage Meetings for Teens, hosted by Cassiopeia Fletcher, Executive Director of Membership & Education. Building on Kimberly Fletcher’s foundational Cottage Meetings program, this interdisciplinary course weaves together American history, classic literature, and the power of personal story to help teens explore the timeless themes of freedom and liberty. Together, they’ll uncover the principles of representative government, individual rights, and religious freedom—core values enshrined in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. But freedom isn’t just a lofty ideal—it begins at home. By nurturing strong values and leadership within the family, we empower teens to create freer communities, stronger states, and ultimately a thriving nation. This course is a powerful step toward raising the next generation of leaders who understand, value, and protect the legacy of liberty. Will your family take the first step in safeguarding freedom for the future? Don’t miss this opportunity—sign up today to join the journey! Missed the first few lessons? That's okay, register anyway and catch-up with the on-demand replays! Through this series, you’ll gain a deeper understanding of the Constitution’s original intent, the ideals that make America exceptional, and the steps needed to restore unity and strength across the nation. Whether you’re a seasoned patriot or new to civic engagement, this is your opportunity to join a nationwide movement to preserve liberty for generations to come. Don’t wait—reserve your spot today and be part of the solution. Together, we can protect and preserve our freedoms and rebuild America’s greatness from the ground up. When she’s not podcasting, you’ll find her running, horseback riding, or playing the piano. Friend, People across the country are fed up with both parties bowing down to billionaires. They want to tax the rich now. They want to keep Social Security and expand Medicare. They are sick and tired of corporate greed running rampant in our policy-making. In a democracy, power should be in the hands of workers, community members, and democratically accountable representatives—not billionaires who are trying to enrich themselves at our expense. We’re calling for a different system, where our basic needs like healthcare are guaranteed, not privatized for profit. **I won’t back down in the fight for a government that serves the people.** **I will always speak truth to power** : I’ve sent letters, signed onto amicus briefs, and supported legislation to protect civil and constitutional rights, public education, Social Security, Head Start, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, the Department of Housing and Urban Development, Urban and Community Forestry grants, illegally fired workers, immigrants, veterans, the postal service, and more. clean_body: We won’t back down in the fight for our rights. | | | Friend, People across the country are fed up with both parties bowing down to billionaires. They want to tax the rich now. They want to keep Social Security and expand Medicare. They are sick and tired of corporate greed running rampant in our policy-making. In a democracy, power should be in the hands of workers, community members, and democratically accountable representatives—not billionaires who are trying to enrich themselves at our expense. We’re calling for a different system, where our basic needs like healthcare are guaranteed, not privatized for profit. I won’t back down in the fight for a government that serves the people. I will always speak truth to power : I’ve sent letters, signed onto amicus briefs, and supported legislation to protect civil and constitutional rights, public education, Social Security, Head Start, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, the Department of Housing and Urban Development, Urban and Community Forestry grants, illegally fired workers, immigrants, veterans, the postal service, and more. I’ve met with federal workers and groups like the Michigan Parent Teacher Association, hosted Know Your Rights workshops, and joined rallies in Washington D.C. and in my district demanding no cuts to our care and no tax cuts for billionaires. I joined activists outside a nearby Republican Congressman’s office to protest proposed cuts to Medicaid: Right now, the richest people in the world are in Trump’s cabinet, and they’re trying to turn us against each other to distract us from their concentration of wealth and power. They’re scapegoating the most vulnerable (including immigrants, Black and brown people, and trans people). We can’t let them: It’s on us to speak up and defend our shared humanity and our constitutional rights to free speech and due process—which apply to everyone who lives here, regardless of immigration status. I will keep resisting the fascist suppression of dissent and illegal kidnappings of immigrants across the country. We won’t back down in the fight for our rights. | ’m using my position on the House Financial Services Committee to question people about Trump's conflicts of interest, and my position on the House Oversight Committee to push for transparency, to hold Trump and Musk accountable, and stand up against the Trump administration’s illegal actions. The Trump administration is continuing to abduct people off the streets, including students who’ve spoken up for human rights and immigrants with valid work visas for no named reason. One legal permanent resident was kidnapped from a Boston airport and tortured during interrogation; he remains behind bars without charges. This is deeply concerning and threatens anyone who speaks out against Trump’s agenda. These violations of our due process rights are also racist: Agents have taken some Native and brown U.S. citizens from their families, only releasing them after being shown Social Security cards or Tribal IDs. I’ve been demanding accountability from the Department of Homeland Security, including leading my colleagues in advocating to release detained students immediately. I won’t stop fighting for everyone’s human and constitutional rights. I will continue pushing back against state violence, and pushing instead for a government that upholds people’s rights and invests in people’s needs. My team has returned over $6.2 million directly back into the pockets of our residents, invested over $52 million in our communities, and assisted more than 10,000 families. We recently helped four residents who received over $136,000 in Social Security benefits they were owed, and who were approved for continued benefits. In addition to introducing legislation to support families with direct cash assistance, I’m also prioritizing constituent services to immediately change the lives of my district’s residents. I’ve trained my colleagues in Congress on how to do this in their districts, because we are here to make people’s lives better, however we can. Republicans are gearing up for victories in the midterms — will you chip in $5 to build the BLUE WAVE to take back our majority? CHIP IN $5 >> [] — Kirsten [] [] A note from Kirsten: Friend, I am truly honored to have won reelection, and I promise to continue the critical work toward bipartisan solutions for New Yorkers as we enter this new term. While we had many victories in New York this election season, our fight to retake control of the Senate is far from over. Please, donate today to make sure my team and I can continue securing crucial progress on the issues that matter the most and help flip the Senate blue in 2026. [] Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

name: Josh Harder
subject: I have an important decision to make
body:
Can you help me decide?

Peter —
I have an important decision to make and I need your help to decide what the right choice is. Let me explain:
As the GOP’s #1 target in the country, I know we have to start organizing early if we’re going to keep this seat blue. People are extremely angry about what the Trump administration is doing right now, and we have to make sure voters understand I'm fighting back.
But that requires early resources.
**So I have a tough call to make: Can we hire our first field staff to get the ball rolling, or do we have to wait until we have more money in the door?**

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20250329-1290-foote&t=1001&akid=1290%2E342411%2EhjLAYl ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

We’re still continuing our push to raise $150,000 by Monday at midnight to
protect our Squad. Ayanna, Ilhan, Rashida, and AOC are leading the fight
against Trump — both in Congress and at rallies across the country, but
this moment calls for all of us to step up.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250329-movement.YDDMP3&refcode=em20250329-1290&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1290%2E342411%2EhjLAYl ]Even $3 will make a difference in this
fight, Peter –
will you chip in?

In case you missed it, AOC and Bernie have been touring the country,
breaking their personal turnout records. In Tucson Arizona, they made
history with the largest political rally in the state’s history with
23,620 people showing up – they expected 3000.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250329-movement.YDDMP3&refcode=em20250329-1290&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=1290%2E342411%2EhjLAYl ][IMG]

These rallies are an opportunity to bring people into our vision for
America. We are uniting people around values like peace, justice, and
equality. We are organizing hundreds of thousands of newly engaged
Americans against the fascist oligarchy.

Our Squad is leading the fight:

✅ For working people — championing fair wages, workers’ rights, and
policies that put working families and marginalized communities first.
✅ To protect public services — fighting back against attacks on Social
Security, Medicaid, and education.
✅ For human rights — standing up to ICE and DHS’s unconstitutional
targeting of immigrants, Palestinians, and people of color.

Being bold, progressive leaders against the Trump oligarchy means that
far-right Republicans, MAGA loyalists, and corrupt billionaires will raise
more money than ever to come after our Squad.

If everyone reading this gave just a little, we could fight back and win.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250329-movement.YDDMP3&refcode=em20250329-1290&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=1290%2E342411%2EhjLAYl ]Can you chip in with $3 to stand up to MAGA and keep our
Squad fighting?

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250329-movement.YDDMP3&refcode=em20250329-1290&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1290%2E342411%2EhjLAYl ]Contribute ››

In solidarity,

The Squad

There are 19 year olds I served with in Afghanistan who took security practices more seriously than this administration.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104754277/536364307/-926250309?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzhlNzExYy1iNzBjLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P4agMzNlrJAQ8fyFh0JXwaqqQvE6GGTJbjVXfZUwA1I=&emci=0e40ea15-b70c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=a78e711c-b70c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=24635485)
I served in the military for 16 years. So when I heard about National Security Advisor Mike Waltz’s group chat shenanigans, I was astonished. **I mean: There are 19 year olds I served with in Afghanistan who took security practices more seriously than this administration.** All the while, this administration has let go of thousands of public servants – many of whom once served our nation – under the guise of “poor performance.” The hypocrisy is outstanding. The American people deserve to know that our nation’s military secrets are safe and that the people who caused this breach are held accountable. [**Add your name if you agree we need immediate investigations into this scandal.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104754282/536364308/479924379?source=20250329-1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzhlNzExYy1iNzBjLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P4agMzNlrJAQ8fyFh0JXwaqqQvE6GGTJbjVXfZUwA1I=&emci=0e40ea15-b70c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=a78e711c-b70c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=24635485) | **[Add Your Name »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104754290/536364311/479924379?source=20250329-1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzhlNzExYy1iNzBjLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P4agMzNlrJAQ8fyFh0JXwaqqQvE6GGTJbjVXfZUwA1I=&emci=0e40ea15-b70c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=a78e711c-b70c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=24635485)**

body:
