**SECURING OUR ELECTIONS** Earlier this week, President Trump signed an executive order that mandates documented proof of US citizenship on voter registration documents. This is great news, **but it's not enough**. The penalty for ignoring this order is simply a loss of federal funding. Granted, that's a big deal, but the states need to codify their own laws to make securing our elections permanent. And that's exactly what our state freedom caucuses are doing. One of the **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** 's top priorities this year was HB 156, which would mandate that only Wyoming citizens vote in Wyoming elections. This common sense bill passed the legislature earlier this year, but the toughest hurdle and the biggest question mark was whether or not liberal Governor Mark Gordon would sign it into law. Well, this past week, he let the bill take effect **_without his signature_**. We'll take it. The WY Freedom Caucus tweeted out the news:
---
[](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjppHen015Gx6AaFY6rk-2BtVm1EbG9EFRY83Mo-2Fm5ndzB3LLqRA8vofjcp1sKs4On6Qcp9qyTshw5VF2w61ZPnAOM-3DJKRy_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHer8r4myu79t2L8I8tbMDoLuzeUCoiN6v1bnWKqC-2Bd-2BRFBurGCMbzOhHeM-2FqLrY6AsRWGxQ6gP9Tc4FHk2DjKB1mssNir-2BnTfF3wtbOVEmx5IXPSZQjeT3hbCLWfm27So9uCThNMU1-2BfMf-2BQ3SDLHgJOE1YGiNziThNx6sTMzWGqSJvSrlYqeMTCqiRMb0VwwD-2Fqqau1qTYqCuvPrKz74Q8QWMzsmY6J16uyA-2BtE-2FDZ91o-3D)

**MARYLAND** We've been giving you a lot of updates lately about the **Maryland Freedom Caucus** because they are in the thick of their legislative session and has done so much to highlight all of The Left's horrible policies.Today, we want to showcase two things. First, Democrats were able to ram their budget through the State House that included over a billion dollars in new taxes. A Democrat state delegate, **Brian Crosby** , is a small business owner who literally moved his IT company to Virginia to avoid Maryland's anti-business climate. Remarkably, he voted for the state budget that included a tax hike on IT services! The MD Freedom Caucus highlighted his hypocrisy here:
---
[](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjiwkZmtXDP4u12gaI7rwUjae8XQZaRZzQyAlLxNMAq3UjrMZczwKrR6UdT1m3CpJo2SxKVjAsCox01C-2FeMOxTOM-3DGyxL_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHer8r4myu79t2L8I8tbMDoLuzeUCoiN6v1bnWKqC-2Bd-2BRFBurGCMbzOhHeM-2FqLrY6AsRWGxQ6gP9Tc4FHk2DjKB1mhTgEeTokziekOSsWZRsLNkABYdfBg9w48nryWxm0p8bRmXLp1cqQMhs3tcaAs3sEUqdrDR8q4HpNJtg3Bip0Ad2Qcp3yx-2BJmumhAN3CZdip4zrLPXv4Ii8o8SFXrWrrZSgb7SH4ZtXxchF-2BL4dUNjk-3D)

Thankfully, the Department of Education's Office for Civil Rights has launched an investigation into this. The **Georgia Freedom Caucus** is [fighting this horrible bill](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjja-2FX-2BHiJMkQeHavsUeprX-2Bmb6rZOv5CYPNdPI-2Bv5JW8oAhDBRXQtxmDEThbRQYA84YpNtPtJ1H0P5Jjl19B2wY-3D_rub_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHer8r4myu79t2L8I8tbMDoLuzeUCoiN6v1bnWKqC-2Bd-2BRFBurGCMbzOhHeM-2FqLrY6AsRWGxQ6gP9Tc4FHk2DjKB1mrn-2BOCxRhbSXB0M-2FRsYUR6QfvlikDcGRR7KswKdDzmMPJeLpGwo7usyUtzpLgIN5lEwASoWhesfU-2FBy7HBXwenSDl1YlWvGXRB3XaRHdwmqj2ynG-2FbqCGIMW3DndND8MetyQKhiIPsL9H3wwJUbdUy4-3D), which would essentially create a "Ministry of Truth" where bureaucrats would decide if campaign material is "materially deceptive." **NO MORE BIG BUDGET** : The **Montana Freedom Caucus** is reminding everyone that they will oppose any state budget that grows too much, creates new full time employee positions, and takes federal dollars with mandates attached to it. clean_body: | | | | Dear Friend, It was another busy week for our state freedom caucuses. Let's dig into it: | SECURING OUR ELECTIONS Earlier this week, President Trump signed an executive order that mandates documented proof of US citizenship on voter registration documents. This is great news, but it's not enough. The penalty for ignoring this order is simply a loss of federal funding. Granted, that's a big deal, but the states need to codify their own laws to make securing our elections permanent. And that's exactly what our state freedom caucuses are doing. One of the Wyoming Freedom Caucus 's top priorities this year was HB 156, which would mandate that only Wyoming citizens vote in Wyoming elections. This common sense bill passed the legislature earlier this year, but the toughest hurdle and the biggest question mark was whether or not liberal Governor Mark Gordon would sign it into law. Well, this past week, he let the bill take effect without his signature. We'll take it. The MD Freedom Caucus highlighted his hypocrisy here: Second, in defense of this massive budget, another liberal Democrat, Delegate Gabriel Acevero , said that paying taxes is "the most patriotic thing you can do". **PREVIOUS EMAIL:** Peter, So far this month, I’ve heard from roughly 3,000 constituents at five town halls. Here are two points I heard over and over: 1\. Trump and Musk’s destruction of our public services, international alliances, and economy is a threat unlike anything we’ve seen before. 2\. **_Democrats in Congress aren’t doing enough. _** I wanted to let you know that **I hear you — loud and clear. ** I take the threats of the Trump administration very seriously. My mom is a paraeducator. My dad was a veteran and a federal employee at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard. My sister relied on Medicaid her whole life. I represent over 27,000 federal workers whose jobs are on Elon Musk’s chopping block. But as angry as I am, I’m also a pragmatist — which means recognizing what I can do IN Congress and what has to happen OUTSIDE Congress. In Congress, my Democratic colleagues and I meet, write letters, and use parliamentary procedure to fight against the worst of the Trump-Musk agenda. It’s slow, deliberative work that doesn’t make flashy headlines. I understand if it feels insufficient in this moment. That’s why this will take ALL of us — not just Congress. We all have a part to play in defending our rights, protecting our communities, and restoring our democracy. So, here are a few things I’m doing OUTSIDE Congress as a candidate, citizen, and organizer: **1\. I’m adopting a swing district!** Starting immediately, we will direct our grassroots energy from Washington’s 6th District to Arizona’s 6th District. The Republican incumbent, Juan Ciscomani, has voted in lockstep with Trump and Musk, even though he won by only 2.5% in 2024 and only 1.5% in 2022. I’m very excited about this new effort — stay tuned for more updates! **2\. I’m hiring a Political Director.** There are limits to what Congressional staff can do politically since they are paid by your tax dollars (yes, we care about ethics!). So, our campaign is hiring a new staffer to work outside the halls of Congress to strengthen our organizing locally and in our adopted swing district. **3\. I’m exploring holding events outside the district.** Democrats are planning [_**People’s Town Halls**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104760043/536382022/1165129692?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.03.29_LongerKick&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZTY0MTcxMi1jMjBjLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Fl5a8cYsAJsawZs7xnMS5GbgcFYvHHlR6-lnwwq-ao=&emci=720bb998-1f0c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=3e641712-c20c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=23483442) in districts where Republican representatives refuse to hold public events. I’m working with DCCC Chair Suzan DelBene and other colleagues to determine my role in this new project. Now, this is the part where I ask you for a donation. These political initiatives cost money, so I’m launching a new _**We Can’t Wait**_ fund to fuel grassroots organizing locally, support our adopted swing district, and put pressure on Republicans in every way we can. During the 2024 campaign, I bet on our powerhouse team of grassroots donors again and again — and you ALWAYS delivered. I know that together, we can meet whatever challenge the Trump administration throws at us. subject: Standing up every day for what’s right

body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104761472/536385400/628041926?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTFmNDJhOTAtYzUwYy1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=UKaqE7f2X7oLnTM7mCE7OEw9-ZiL7thVGH_iXYQTt_o=) Eighteen years ago, I completed my final treatment for breast cancer. Surviving cancer made me realize I couldn’t put off pursuing the goals I was passionate about, friend, and it made me reevaluate the impact that I could make on the world with whatever time I was privileged enough to have. Now, every day I stand up — for my oath, the Constitution, and my constituents. And every day, the people of Los Angeles continue to inspire me. I know they’re worth fighting for. I know so many of you are worried about our nation. But we are winning in the courts. We are changing minds. And we will not quit. But our fight to regain our country from extremists is only beginning. There are battles ahead and we need everyone involved and engaged. I hope you'll stick with us as we continue to deliver for our district and the country. Peter, In less than one week, voters will choose the next Wisconsin Supreme Court justice. I’m proud to support Judge Susan Crawford. She’s a fair, impartial jurist who has dedicated her career to protecting the rights, freedoms, and safety of all citizens. And it was an honor to go back to Wisconsin and campaign for her earlier this week. I’m all-in on this election because of a basic truth: **the outcome will determine if Wisconsin continues to be a beacon of hope in our quest for a true democracy – or not.[So I’m asking if you can make a donation today to help elect candidates like Judge Crawford in the Badger State and across the country.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104763186/536390637/790884352?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_HolderWisconsin_email_20250329-NDRC-Tier1-HolderWisconsinNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250329-NDRC-Tier1-HolderWisconsinNOR_&utm_campaign=HolderWisconsin&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNhYjU5YmE4LWM3MGMtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VbtGGaw_G3um2_89-deS-tmL-I9nkaLKKIXAlGqh-tU=)** **Wisconsin’s recent history reminds us that no matter how bleak things may look, we can still make change. No matter how tightly some anti-democracy leaders try to cling to unearned power, the will of the people can still prevail — as long as the people have the will to fight. ** When we began, the challenges in the Badger State could have seemed insurmountable. Conservatives had held control of Wisconsin’s highest court for more than a decade. Republican Governor Scott Walker and his allies had egregiously gerrymandered the state legislature to create artificially large GOP majorities. And for years, Wisconsinites were forced to live under unpopular policies enacted by those Republican majorities, despite the fact that Democrats saw increasing — and sometimes majority — statewide support. To be blunt: Wisconsin was governed by illegitimate minority rule. But the people of the Badger State did not give up. They organized. They voted. They forged a new chapter for their state. And at the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, we had their back. We helped elect Democrat Tony Evers as governor. And because we knew then, like we know now, that fair-minded state supreme courts are vital to defending democracy, we invested in flipping control of the court, year after year. I supported fair-minded Wisconsin Supreme Court candidates in 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2023, visiting the state ahead of each of those elections and helping to rally voters. That long game culminated in the election of Judge Janet Protasiewicz in 2023, which broke the conservative stranglehold on the court. **The election was a reminder that in order to protect democracy, we must do democracy.** With a new majority on the bench and Tony Evers serving as governor, the gerrymandered state legislative maps’ days were numbered. Under new, fair maps in 2024, Democrats broke the Republican supermajority in the state senate and flipped seats in the state assembly, creating a path to win majorities in 2026. It was a new chapter for democracy in Wisconsin. That brings us to today, Peter, and the task before us: Electing Judge Susan Crawford and Democracy Defenders across the country. **If the far-right candidate wins, Wisconsin would lose its hard-won, pro-democracy state supreme court majority. The state’s highest court would go back to its extreme past of rolling back rights rather than protecting them.** In contrast, winning this race would mean building on the pro-democracy momentum we’ve worked so hard to create since we founded the National Democratic Redistricting Committee. And it would continue a model of success that can be applied to some of the most appallingly gerrymandered states today like North Carolina, Texas, Florida, and Ohio. **Our movement has been fighting for fairness state by state, year by year — we are playing the righteous long game. [I hope you’ll support us with a gift today to power the work ahead.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104763187/536390638/790884352?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_HolderWisconsin_email_20250329-NDRC-Tier1-HolderWisconsinNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250329-NDRC-Tier1-HolderWisconsinNOR_&utm_campaign=HolderWisconsin&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNhYjU5YmE4LWM3MGMtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VbtGGaw_G3um2_89-deS-tmL-I9nkaLKKIXAlGqh-tU=)** Thank you,

| Dear friends. We know these are disheartening and frustrating times. Donald Trump and Elon Musk are unleashing chaos on our government and the people of this country. From firing hundreds of staff only to rehire them the next day, to sharing military plans in a group chat with a reporter, to cutting Medicaid to pay for billionaire tax cuts, people are rightfully angry. And many of you are crying out for someone to **_“DO SOMETHING”_** about all of this. We get it. As the California Democratic Party, there’s only so much we can do directly in Washington DC. _But that doesn’t mean we are sitting on our hands_. Here’s what we are doing directly to empower our representatives and take the fight to Donald Trump and Elon Musk: 1️⃣ We launched a **_MASSIVE organizing campaign_** that’s targeting swing seat Republicans. We’ve already made countless calls and are running digital activations as well. 2️⃣ We just held our **_first grassroots town hall_** in one of the most vulnerable GOP districts that we plan to flip from red to blue. We want to do more of these meetings across the state! 3️⃣ We are supporting California Strong Democrats who are standing up to Trump, including Senator Adam Schiff, Senator Alex Padilla, and **_Attorney General Rob Bonta who is suing Donald Trump_** — among many others. **[We know these are very scary times. | | This case is still going on in North Carolina, Team,**** and we have to keep spreading the word because the mainstream media continues to ignore election theft in plain sight. **The North Carolina state Supreme Court stepped in to stop the certification of the election for a justice on their court** , which is a huge breach of power and a clearly partisan action in a state where judges are affiliated with political parties. **For background:** On Election Day, incumbent Justice Allison Riggs (D) was reelected by a slim margin of a few hundred votes. Her disgruntled opponent, GOP Judge Jefferson Griffin, sued for and received two separate recounts -- _both of which increased Riggs' lead._ Now, a coalition of more than 200 North Carolina jurists, attorneys, state government officials, bar leaders and legal educators signed on to a letter this month to Judge Griffin to end his effort to overturn the results of the 2024 election. “ _The arguments you have advanced ask our judicial system to change the rules in place for the 2024 election after it has run its course. Indeed, if you succeed, tens of thousands of voters will lose their voice after they voted,_ ” the letter states. “ _For the sake of our judicial system, we ask you to terminate your litigation now_.” [**We must keep the pressure up to stop this post-election interference with legitimate votes. I’m honored to be stepping into a new role as chair of the Minnesota DFL. | | | **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104765118/536395715/247480370?refcode=header&amount=75&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzU5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMWIwY2UzMS1jZDBjLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kZtoeiXm7Iph8iUAEEUXjP6v7gNrUkeTut4k0atc5cg=)**
---
Peter, I’m Richard Carlbom, and I’m honored to be stepping into a new role as chair of the Minnesota DFL. I got involved in politics because I wanted to help improve people’s lives. I know that’s what drives many of you too, and I’m committed to fighting for those shared values as DFL chair. Together, we’ll build a stronger, more successful party and deliver meaningful change. To turn our values into action, we need a clear plan. When I was running for chair, I made three key commitments:
* **We will organize:** We can’t wait until election year to engage with voters. Our party will start organizing earlier, especially in Greater Minnesota and communities that are too often the last to receive attention.****
* **We will have deeply relational conversations with voters:** Many voters are conflicted. To build trust with people that walked away from our candidates in the last election, we’ll listen to and learn from Minnesotans.
* **We will launch a rapid response war room:** We’ll create a new war room to deliver messaging, tools, and clear action steps to local leaders, volunteers, candidates, and activists. This will help us engage more communities and elevate voices that resonate with voters.

This model will help us continue our statewide winning streak, but we’re going to invest in local races too. We’re going to do the work—talking with voters in red and purple districts and making sure DFLers turnout. And together, we’re going to win tough races. **Peter, I’m ready to get to work—and I know you are too. Let’s get out there!**
Thank you, Richard Carlbom
Chair
Minnesota DFL **** ****

name: Andy Beshear
subject: There's no way around it: what the Kentucky GOP voted for is cruel
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
House Bill 495 hit my desk this past weekend, and I vetoed it, Peter.
Over the weekend, House Bill 495 hit my desk — **and I vetoed it.**

This bill is an attempt to overturn my executive order banning conversion therapy for minors.

I refuse to put our kids in harm’s way, and I will continue to make it clear that conversion therapy is wrong and cruel. **When did it become okay to use a partisan agenda to harm our kids?**

Instead of working to make Kentucky a better place for everyone, extreme politicians are playing political games with people’s lives. That’s not leadership — it’s dangerous — and it’s wrong. I even said so during this month’s Fairness Rally at our State Capitol: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104767003/536401943/-627450706?refcode=em25_250329_eoq1_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_campaign=em25_250329_eoq1_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=1f24b504-d10c-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWYyNGI1MDQtZDEwYy1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SJBcb2SrQgRIDqnD1XuxZbv9hWtn5yCs0zTE15_n1bs=)
I’m about moving our state and our country forward. I’m about moving away from anger politics and bringing the focus back to the people. I’m about standing up for what’s right, even when it’s tough... _but Peter, I can’t do it alone._

That’s why I’m working to elect leaders who won’t fall for these partisan games — leaders with honesty, integrity, and a commitment to serving the people, not themselves. Kentuckians deserve leadership that puts them first, not politicians who prioritize personal and political gain at the expense of the people they swore to represent.

Friends, This is it, the final stretch. And just as we expected, MAGA super PACs and Trump’s billionaire donors are dumping a massive wave of cash into this race, trying to drown us out in the final days. Millions of dollars are being spent on attack ads, misleading mailers, and last-minute voter suppression efforts. They are doing everything in their power to buy this seat and keep Trump’s hand-picked candidate in Congress. **Hell, even ELON MUSK is getting in on it now. He’s spending tens of thousands to help the MAGA side. Unacceptable!** They are going all in because they know what is at stake. They know that if we win here, it will be a crushing blow to Trump’s Project 2025 agenda before it even begins. They know that flipping this seat would weaken their hold on the House and disrupt their entire operation heading into November. They are desperate to stop us, and they think they can do it with a blank check from their billionaire donors. We have fought too hard and come too far to let them buy this race at the last second. _This guest column originally[appeared](https://substack.com/redirect/74fd48d5-0841-4daa-84ce-e8ad0dfaf328?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the Substack of journalist Jonathan Larsen, a veteran of ABC, CNN, and MSNBC, who served as executive producer of Up with Chris Hayes. He shared it with us to cross-post. You can subscribe to Jonathan's Substack [here](https://substack.com/redirect/04560bc9-3eb2-4eb4-b1ae-460143cc9536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)._
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7294a602-5fa2-4b13-a2ff-f18018af7e65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Secretary of State Marco Rubio, National Security Adviser Mike Waltz, and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth discuss prioritizing America's interests on Jan. 28, 2025, less than two months before agreeing to bail out Europe with a U.S. military strike. (Uncredited / White House [photo](https://substack.com/redirect/49063bb0-c523-450a-920d-56170f4ea567?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
There's something important missing from the [fully released](https://substack.com/redirect/d41e4822-6c53-4c34-9e8c-1e0f7c39a9f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)[1](https://substack.com/redirect/3124b1d3-0592-448e-9942-17bcd6b86da0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Signal group chat of top national-security personnel regarding the March 15, 2025, airstrike against Houthi targets in Yemen. I assumed by now someone more schooled in military and natsec matters would flag it, but I haven't seen that, so let's take a crack at it.
By now, people are probably familiar with the dispute between Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Atlantic Editor-in-Chief Jeffrey Goldberg over whether the details Hegseth shared constituted a "war plan."
Either way, it's pretty clear the details posed a [potential security threat](https://substack.com/redirect/3bdcdb8c-3d1d-45b3-b393-8a63d0ce81c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the pilots involved; a threat averted only because Goldberg kept those details secret. But what struck me most about the plan was the absence of an after-plan.
Okay, you drop the bombs. Then what? What was the theory under which this would achieve Pres. Donald Trump's stated goal of reopening the waters of the Red Sea to commercial navigation?
Or was the extent of it really just what Vice Pres. JD Vance said: To send a message.
To...someone. About...something. To some end. Presumably.
If so, there's no indication anyone got that message. Trump [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/395aab27-5556-431e-92fe-fc2282fc2d22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) afterward that the Houthis had waged an "unrelenting campaign" against U.S. and other ships. But the campaign had relented once Israel allowed humanitarian aid into Gaza.
And Trump called the March 15 attack "decisive." But nothing's changed in the two weeks since except the frequency of attacks by both sides. The attack appears to have achieved nothing but escalation. (In fairness, Pres. Joe Biden also didn't seem to achieve much; Houthi activity has correlated pretty reliably with Israeli behavior in Gaza. But Biden didn't mount anything of this scale.)
The Signal chat reveals no suggestion of a strategic framework -- or even the concept of a plan -- into which the attack clearly fit. That was true in the chat before the attack took place but also, most strikingly, afterward.
Beforehand, Vance addressed the reasons for doing it. If there were some long-term strategy at work, you'd expect to hear about it here. But according to Vance the best reason for the attack was messaging...and the attack was _in conflict_ with their messaging:
> > The strongest reason to do this is, as POTUS said, to send a message. But I am not sure the president is aware how inconsistent this is with his message on Europe right now.
Even on the strongest rationale for the attack, it wasn't a consistent part of what they were already doing, let alone planning to do.
And after Hegseth confirmed the "success" of the initial attack, among the emojis and fist-bumping there was zero indication that now... _something_ else was supposed to happen next. Covert messaging to the Iranians about cutting off the Houthis? Back-channel communications with the Houthis themselves about possible negotiations?
Secretary of State Marco Rubio was on the group chat, but offered nothing even hinting at a follow-up diplomatic component. To the contrary, the chat speaks to precisely the opposite.
Discussing pushing back the attack, Office of the Director of National Intelligence contact Joe Kent said, "There is nothing time sensitive driving the time line."
Hegseth confirmed: "Waiting a few weeks or a month does not fundamentally change the calculus...we can easily pause."
The implication: There _were no_ other, planned actions in the works that would be upended based on the timing of the strike. Hegseth just wanted to beat the Israelis to the punch.
The closest thing to any kind of strategic thought was Vance raising the prospect of trying to minimize risks to oil facilities of the Saudis (who are fighting the Houthis). Literally no one even responded.
After the attack, there's a chorus of attaboys and well dones. No mention of anything next on the to-do list. Curtain closes. Exeunt.
The only thing achieved by the bombing, apparently, was the bombing. As New York Times Editorial Board member Farah Stockman [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/0617407a-4317-4f55-b207-88eebfc27fda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),
> > What feels revelatory about the Signal chat is just how unserious this national security team is. It's not just the emojis or the accidental inclusion of a journalist or the decision to communicate on that app. It's how focused members of the chat group were on how the attack would be perceived by Trump's base, rather than on the potential geopolitical repercussions of their actions.
Her assessment -- and the lack of an overarching plan -- are consistent with what current __ Defense Department officials [told CNN](https://substack.com/redirect/74dced0e-f084-459f-9327-cf54eac4b7e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Hegseth doesn't do plans.
It's not just that a number of Hegseth's public initiatives were almost immediately scaled back due to apparent lack of planning or consideration. Pentagon officials told CNN that Hegseth simply isn't deliberative. Like Trump, Hegseth leads the U.S. military on impulse:
> > "He's a TV personality," one of the sources said. "[A general officer] makes a recommendation, and he's like, 'Yeah, yeah, go do it.' [Former Defense Secretary] Lloyd Austin would never be like, 'Yeah, yeah, go do it.' He'd be like, 'We'll take it under consideration.'"

In fact, CNN [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/74dced0e-f084-459f-9327-cf54eac4b7e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), earlier this month, Hegseth sent a warship -- most recently intercepting Houthi attacks in the Red Sea -- to the U.S. coast near the Mexican border. How come? "Optics," a Pentagon source told CNN.
Hegseth sent 900 troops to Guantanamo Bay in February to help guard deportees. But the surge of deportees never materialized, so those troops are now expected to go home.
And the secret chat revealed a glaring flaw even in the Trump administration's "plan" for getting Europe to pay for this. As I [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/a85e7ee1-f8ec-4c45-9fa7-5cc13d7f92ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) earlier this week, one day after the attack, Hegseth appeared on Fox arguing that the attack was in America's national interest.
But just two days earlier, in the group chat, he and the others were discussing Trump's desire to make Europe pay for it. How would that attempt square with Hegseth claiming publicly that America benefited? Two days after plotting to get Europe to pick up the tab, Hegseth undermined the U.S. rationale for that argument on TV.
The point isn't to pile on Hegseth. Hell, Trump himself, on the day of the attack, [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/395aab27-5556-431e-92fe-fc2282fc2d22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that it was "to protect American shipping, air, and naval assets." Also undercutting their "plan" to make Europe pay for it.
The reason for focusing on Hegseth is simply that he would have been the most likely source of discussions about followup military plans -- if there were any beyond just more of the same.
But Rubio, too, might have been expected to chime in about diplomatic aspects of any Trump strategy here. The timing of the attack, for instance, would in theory have affected plans for diplomatic outreach before and after. (There was some discussion of informing allies, but no reference to pursuing anything diplomatically alongside the attack.)
And yet, there was no mention from Rubio or anyone else of any diplomacy beyond briefing allies that the strikes were happening.
The lack of security around the strikes is certainly stunning and chilling in the disregard for armed forces in harm's way. But even that disregard pales in comparison to how cheaply U.S. military lives are valued as we start to recognize that they're being moved around the global chessboard by a team that's not even bothering to play chess.

#### **ANNOUNCEMENT: Captain Seth Keshel and Dr. Chris Mattmann Join Frozen Odds Movie as Featured Experts**
**We’re honored to announce that Seth Keshel, MBA, will be featured in Frozen Odds, the powerful documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).****Seth Keshel is a former Army Captain of Military Intelligence and Afghanistan veteran. His analytical method of election forecasting and analytics is known worldwide, and he has been commended by President Donald J. Trump for his work in the field. He most recently made headlines by correctly forecasting a 312-226 Trump victory in the Electoral College, with accurate picks in all 56 races for electoral votes.****Captain Keshel proposes 10 Points to True Election Integrity and has identified Ranked Choice Voting as one of the eight cardinal sins of election administration. He toured Alaska in the spring of 2022 while fighting the information battle associated with promoting election integrity.****In Frozen Odds, Captain Keshel will bring his expert analysis and firsthand experience to expose the flaws of RCV and its impact on election integrity.****Dr. Chris Mattmann Joins Frozen Odds as Featured Expert****We’re thrilled to announce that Dr. Chris Mattmann, a leading AI and data expert, will be featured in Frozen Odds, a powerful documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).****Dr. Mattmann’s career is nothing short of extraordinary. He is the Chief Data and AI Officer at UCLA, former Chief Technology and Innovation Officer at NASA JPL, and President of Mattmann.ai. An accomplished author and industry leader, he has played key roles in advancing AI, big data, and technology across multiple fields.****With firsthand experience in RCV from his time at the Apache Software Foundation, Dr. Mattmann will break down its flaws in Frozen Odds, sharing his expert insights and concerns based on real-world applications.****Stay tuned—Frozen Odds is coming soon to reveal the truth behind Alaska’s fight for fair elections.**

**Starting a film project for Amazon Prime, YouTube, etc. – Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process, Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down?**

Groups backed by the richest man in the world are dumping _millions_ into Wisconsin’s upcoming Supreme Court race to prop up a pro-Trump candidate. Elon Musk’s PAC has spent huge sums in this race. His America PAC is the biggest outside spender in the race so far, spending more than $12 million to benefit ultra-conservative candidate Brad Schimel. subject: Unleashing excellence
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VIVEK RAMASWAMY FOR OHIO
body:
It's simple: if you're not performing, you're not getting paid

It's simple: if you're not performing, you're not getting paid
It's simple: if you're not performing, you're not getting paid

| | | | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-9Y_hZGsBs4joTe3Qw)
---

Peter,

The failed education bureaucracy in America had its chance to get it right. And what do we have to show for it? A system that rewards tenure over performance, promotes victimhood, and lowers standards to paper over failure.

Meanwhile, our children are left to suffer the consequences.

**Today, 70% of U.S. 8th graders are NOT proficient in reading. That 's unacceptable. As Governor, I'll take a wrecking ball to the entire system. **

I won't play nice with the entrenched special interests holding our children back. It's time to build a new system that rewards EXCELLENCE. Ohio will be the first state in the nation to implement merit-based pay for public school teachers.

Teaching is a noble profession. And if you're a rockstar educator who's getting results, you can expect to be compensated handsomely for your excellence. On the other hand, low performers will no longer climb the ladder like everyone else.

This isn't a partisan issue. This is a common-sense revolution that will change the future of education.

But the education bureaucracy won't go down without a fight. Neither will the corrupt teacher's unions. They'll throw everything they've got at us to try and stop this reform from EVER happening. That's why I need your support.

Will you help us fix our education crisis?
**[SIGN MY PETITION: Institute merit-based pay for public school teachers!](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews. "SIGN MY PETITION: Institute merit-based pay for public school teachers!")**

---

"consider making a contribution to our campaign today.")** We're not just fighting for education reform - we're fighting for the future of our state.

It's time to take a stand and fight for what's right. Join me in this revolution to transform our system and give our children the education they deserve.

God Bless you and God Bless America,

Vivek Ramaswamy
Candidate for Governor of Ohio

Friend, I am an engineer, an outdoorsman, and a dad raising a family in a place I love. And I am fighting everyday to deliver a future where our kids can build their lives and thrive right here at home. New Mexico’s landscapes are unparalleled, our cultural traditions are unmatched, and our people are kind and resilient. Did you know that 50,000 of your brain cells die every day?

**If you’re over 50 and you forget a name, misplace your keys, or just feel foggy all the time — that means your brain cells are dying off even faster.**

I was shocked to learn this myself.

It turns out... _Stanford University_ neuroscientists identified a nasty “cell invader.” It attacks cells in the memory center of your brain - the hippocampus - causing your brain to shrink.

Thankfully there’s something you can do from home to clear it out.

[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jsGOsyAURp8GdzVwEdAFi_8f007SppvJLGZJASstiEVG07efaJrubr57knNUGL3rnhKJ_wigd2ZCAIj-QwCPnyWk31s4Hnans0m7Bz8Htn7h44XO8IYHrQ4n83Vj8budGhI-48KPM3nj-TnaN_ySljYo59dVtIWRtDO4KqwkoqJQ85pWRS8vTSN03QkiFMaUMcYqWgnAnGuiGkMLJwEDwxQaAMAUlytBWFNrLGquDEMV3jylCjY5rciUF5VSjKHUMRRe9jmP0xa2R7Dv41hq7_T9ooZ7Odi8znSvus55p7JFtA1AyRUBn-1gYloHG2J6Lgj46Ayi7Tx5BDxvt72q0Lm0ScOiZrulsiJJMy7OezdxgSp83RLXoFnCXwAAAP__w4Z5eA)

This Brain Clearance process is critical for flushing out toxic invaders from your hippocampus.

The 17,789 Americans who’ve tried this report improved memory and boosted brain power.

For the last 12 months, my team and I have been lucky enough to partner with Dr. James Rivers, the MIT-Trained neuroscientist who discovered this method.

Dr. Rivers has spent the better part of his career studying senescent cells, which is the technical term for the “brain invaders” that can shrivel up your brain’s memory center.

He’s considered one of New York City’s top brain doctors, and after he showed his 8-second daily ritual to his parents & in-laws...

They could only describe the sharp mental clarity they felt as “a cloud being lifted.” That's why so many seniors have called it a “memory miracle” or a “total game changer.”

This is a totally new way to address the root cause of brain fog, fuzzy thinking, and depleted brain power...and you can do it from home without any pills or exercise.

(The secret is in your ears.)

#### **Exciting News, Rep. David Eastman is joining citizens to craft legislation.**
---
---
|
---
**Rep. David Eastman (R-Wasilla) has been a consistent conservative voice in the Alaska House since 2017. A West Point graduate and former Army Military Police Captain, Eastman has dedicated much of his life to public service—including volunteering as a firefighter, EMT, and disaster responder.****He played key roles in Alaska’s conservative movement, including leading efforts for the Trump 2016 campaign and supporting Joe Miller’s 2010 U.S. Senate run. Eastman was also the first legislator in Alaska to introduce a bill to repeal ranked-choice voting, aiming to restore clarity and transparency to the electoral process.****Looking ahead, he’s working alongside Alaskans to draft legislation—through citizen petition and public engagement—that would make President Trump’s Executive Orders on election integrity permanent law in Alaska.****A lifelong advocate for constitutional principles, Eastman lives in Wasilla with his wife and five children, continuing his commitment to service, family, and the values that shape Alaska’s future.**

---
|
---

**I setup the option to give $50, $100, or $250. We are going to bring the RCV Lobby Vs Alaskans to screens everywhere. Just in the last year, I have had over 6.5 million views on my X account.**

**Featured Experts:**
* **Captain Seth Keshel**
* **Background:** Former Army Captain, Military Intelligence, Afghanistan veteran.
* **Expertise:** Election forecasting; critic of RCV as a threat to election integrity.
* **Contribution:** Analysis of how RCV undermined election integrity in Alaska.
* **Dr. Chris Mattmann**
* **Background:** Chief Data and AI Officer at UCLA, former NASA JPL CTIO.
* **Expertise:** AI, big data, and election data complexities.
* **Contribution:** Insights on RCV’s technical challenges and voter disenfranchisement risks.
* **RC Maxwell**
* **Background:** Investigative journalist, formerly with Project Veritas, now with Newsmax.
* **Expertise:** Exposed political manipulation surrounding RCV in Alaska.
* **Contribution:** Revealed strategic efforts to influence Alaska’s elections using RCV.
* **Former Alaska Attorney General Kevin Clarkson**
* **Background:** Former Alaska Attorney General with legal expertise in RCV challenges.
* **Expertise:** Legal complexities of RCV and voter rights concerns.
* **Contribution:** Detailed analysis of Alaska's legal battles over RCV.
* **Former Lt. Governor Mead Treadwell**
* **Background:** Former Alaska Lt. Governor who oversaw state elections.
* **Expertise:** Election management and administrative challenges tied to RCV.
* **Contribution:** Insights on RCV’s impact on voter trust and election administration.

**Summary:**
These experts collectively provide a comprehensive view of RCV's legal, political, and technical flaws, highlighting the system's impact on Alaska’s electoral process and voter confidence.
---
---
|
---
**Starting a film project for Amazon Prime, YouTube, etc. – Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process, Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down?**

| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only weeks away. And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate... ...to Jesus. And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood... ...by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love. Here’s exactly what their strategy is... First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic. In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin. Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible. And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS! That's why step one of Brave Books' "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stwp6d&__onlt=h)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission... Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture. Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive. But I know we can do it. Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries. >>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great. >>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
---
And listen to this... **[**Your "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100 or more, not only helps fund this revival campaign that makes Jesus the reason for the Easter season once more...**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stwp6d&__onlt=h)** Your gift helps Brave Books complete a groundbreaking comprehensive homeschool curriculum that gives parents an alternative to woke government schools. AND your gift helps Brave Books begin work on an historic Gospel book series that will bring the Bible to life for a generation of children and parents in desperate need of God's truth. But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you **[contribute $100 or more to the "Prepare the Way" revival](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stwp6d&__onlt=h)** , Brave Books will send you _Saving the Easter Bunny_ absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep _Saving the Easter Bunny_ for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. **[**What's most important is that you rush back your best "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100, or more right away.**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stwp6d&__onlt=h)** Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America.
---
May God bless you this coming Easter season,

House Republicans have one of the slimmest majorities in nearly a decade, and they’re using every ounce of their power to push for cuts to federal funding for critical programs like Medicaid and Social Security.

It’s clear that the only way to hold the Trump Administration accountable is by taking back the House in 2026. That’s why we’re launching **Operation 2026** — _our plan to secure a strong Democratic majority that will fight for hardworking families!_

Team,**

** Just how bad is the GOP candidate running in the FL-06 special election? So bad, that even Ron DeSantis, who famously inserted platform lifts in his shoes to make himself seem taller when he ran for president in 2024, thinks he is a uniquely phony nominee.

The guy is so bad that Donald Trump has offered his boilerplate “Complete and Total!” endorsement of Randy Fine over Truth Social at least three times now—his latest coming in hot just this afternoon **during the last day of early voting in this race** :****

|
---
| [ ](https://yqlzye.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwODE2MzUsXCJsXCI6MTUwMjQ4Njc3NjM1NTI0NDYyLFwiclwiOjE1MDI0ODgwODg2NTg1ODYyMX0iLCJzIjoiMWNhZGU2M2YwYzNjNzQ0NSJ9)
---
|
---
How many times does Donald Trump need to say that a MAGA Republican has his endorsement? _The lady doth protest too much, methinks._

Randy Fine isn’t losing because MAGA voters aren’t sure where Trump stands on the race. Hi, it’s Secretary of State Tobias Read.
As we speak, Republicans across the country are working to silence voters.
Here’s how: Congress is working on a bill called the SAVE Act, which would create burdensome barriers for millions of eligible voters. If the bill were to pass, as many as 21 million legal voters would struggle to be able to cast their ballots.
And the majority of those affected would be voters who regularly participate in our democracy!
These restrictions aren’t about protecting elections; they’re about making it harder for people to vote. And if passed, the SAVE Act could become a dangerous model for future efforts to roll back access to the ballot nationwide.
That’s where Secretaries of State like me come in. Offices like mine around the country are working to make sure that voters’ voices are never silenced by a bill like this. But I need your help.
I am approaching my first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline since taking office, and I need to raise $5,000 between now and March 31 to hit my fundraising goal. With voting rights on the line, I urgently need you to donate $20 to my team right now. Your gift today will make a major impact. clean_body: [] Hi, it’s Secretary of State Tobias Read. As we speak, Republicans across the country are working to silence voters. Here’s how: Congress is working on a bill called the SAVE Act, which would create burdensome barriers for millions of eligible voters. If the bill were to pass, as many as 21 million legal voters would struggle to be able to cast their ballots. And the majority of those affected would be voters who regularly participate in our democracy! These restrictions aren’t about protecting elections; they’re about making it harder for people to vote. And if passed, the SAVE Act could become a dangerous model for future efforts to roll back access to the ballot nationwide. That’s where Secretaries of State like me come in. Offices like mine around the country are working to make sure that voters’ voices are never silenced by a bill like this. But I need your help. I am approaching my first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline since taking office, and I need to raise $5,000 between now and March 31 to hit my fundraising goal.
